%y: Formatted y value, as after above option.
Examples:
"(%x, %y)": x (East / West) first.
"（%x、%y）"
"(%y, %x)": y (South / North) first.
"（%y、%x）"

leighzerburiedscience.label: Exclude high tech sciences from starting area.
leighzerburiedscience.description: If set to true, science pack patches that are more advanced than chemical science will be placed outside of the starting area.

Everything_is_explosive.label: Range added to explosion
Everything_is_explosive.description: Higher the value, higher the max space between entities that explosion of one will damage the other.

Everything_is_explosive.label: Chance entity explodes
Everything_is_explosive.description: Chance entity explodes after being destroyed.

autodrive.label: Follow sensor proximity (10-1000)
autodrive.description: Vehicles with a follow-player sensor will try to stay within this many tiles of the player.\nDefault: 20

ja-mod.label: Follow sensor proximity (10-1000)
ja-mod.description: Vehicles with a follow-player sensor will try to stay within this many tiles of the player.\nDefault: 20

autodrive.label: Heal friendly entities on collision
autodrive.description: Turn this on if you don't want to destroy your base while driving!\nDefault: on

ja-mod.label: Heal friendly entities on collision
ja-mod.description: Turn this on if you don't want to destroy your base while driving!\nDefault: on

autodrive.label: Heal vehicle on collision with trees
autodrive.description: If this option is active, trees are your friends: Just bump your vehicle into them for instant regeneration! (Nobody said you were the trees' friend …)\nDefault: on

ja-mod.label: Heal vehicle on collision with trees
ja-mod.description: If this option is active, trees are your friends: Just bump your vehicle into them for instant regeneration! (Nobody said you were the trees' friend …)\nDefault: on

PersistentAutosaves.label: Active
PersistentAutosaves.description: Set true if mod should create autosaves, false otherwise.

PersistentAutosaves.label: Ticks Between Autosaves
PersistentAutosaves.description: Interval between autosaves, in game-ticks. Default: 18000 (5 mins)

PersistentAutosaves.label: User Set ID
PersistentAutosaves.description: String included in each autosave filename.

MultiplayerSpawnOptions.label: Change location on start game
MultiplayerSpawnOptions.description: Change location on start game.\nTo work other mods through the interface.

MultiplayerSpawnOptions.label: Create a new team for new players
MultiplayerSpawnOptions.description: Create a new team for new players.\nEach created force has its own research progression.

MultiplayerSpawnOptions.label: Disable the ability to kill players
MultiplayerSpawnOptions.description: Disable the ability to kill players.\nDisable Friendly fire and limit deconstruction planner.\nAutomatic ceasefire and friendly between every single force.

MultiplayerSpawnOptions.label: Disable console commands for respawn
MultiplayerSpawnOptions.description: Disable console commands for respawn.\May be required by admin.

Hazard-Lights-Selection-Tool.label: The people who should be able to see things selected by you

CRSeaBlockRebalance.label: Re-enable Bob's Water Borers
CRSeaBlockRebalance.description: Turns the water boring techs back on for Bob's "Water Pumps". Note that you'll need to enable Bob's Plates "groundwater" setting ("Enable ground water boring recipes"), and the rebalance disables the purified water recipe from those pumps.

TJQuickStart.label: Ship Wreck
TJQuickStart.description: Appear Ship Wreck. if turn this off, you get only items.

TJQuickStart.label: With bonus items
TJQuickStart.description: if you want only appearance of ship-wreck and don't need cheat-items, turn this off.

TJQuickStart.label: With bonus oil
TJQuickStart.description: Create an oil-field near starting position. (but it's very small.)

homeworld-reloaded.label: Homeworld type
homeworld-reloaded.description: Determines the type of Homeworld you are supporting. Do not change this setting for a game in progress, or be prepared for a significant drop in population while you are adjusting for the new requirements.

homeworld-reloaded.label: Enable statistics
homeworld-reloaded.description: Add the items sent to the homeworld, to the production statistics window

homeworld-reloaded.label: Enable wood recipe
homeworld-reloaded.description: Gives you a basic way to generate wood. Disable this if you prefer another way, such as Bob's Greenhouse mod

rpg_items.label: Price Multiplier
rpg_items.description: The prices are balanced so that you can afford 6 items in 50 hours of playtime.\nPlease adjust this setting if your games last longer.

m-rpg_items.label: Price Multiplier
m-rpg_items.description: The prices are balanced so that you can afford 6 items in 50 hours of playtime.\nPlease adjust this setting if your games last longer.

PowerPlusPowerMeter.label: Power meter update interval (ticks)
PowerPlusPowerMeter.description: How often the power meter will update its readings. This implementation shouldn't be UPS intensive, so it should be okay to run the update every tick, but you can turn it down if you want.

LogiNetChannels.label: Network Channel Limit
LogiNetChannels.description:
Maximum number of logistic network channels per player faction (1-50).

WARNING: each channel creates a new faction, and there is a hard limit of 60 factions per game!  For example, if there are three player factions, then the channel limit should be set no higher than 19 (19*3 + 3 = 60)
NOTE: when reducing the channel limit, any entities assigned to the removed channels get reassigned to channel 0

LogiNetChannels.label: Show channel info on hover
LogiNetChannels.description: When enabled, channel information will be shown in the upper left corner when hovering the cursor over logistics entities

LogiNetChannels.label: Channels require research
LogiNetChannels.description: When enabled, channel technology must be researched before channels can be used

echo-combinator.label: Echo Name
echo-combinator.description: Listener Name of your Echo Combinators.

No_Wood_For_Bob.label: Basic underground belt
No_Wood_For_Bob.description: Replace wood in basic underground belt recipe

No_Wood_For_Bob.label: Basic splitter
No_Wood_For_Bob.description: Replace wood in basic splitter recipe

OldOre.description: If enabled, changing stone item texture on texture from Factorio 0.16.x

OldOre.description: If enabled, changing coal item texture on texture from Factorio 0.16.x

OldOre.description: If enabled, changing iron ore item texture on texture from Factorio 0.16.x

OldOre.description: If enabled, changing uranium ore item texture on texture from Factorio 0.16.x

karosieben_modpack.label: Build Distance Bonus
karosieben_modpack.description: Bonus distance for building. Can be up to 100000. Also works in map view. Set to zero for vanilla experience.

karosieben_modpack.label: Reach Distance Bonus
karosieben_modpack.description: Bonus distance for interacting. Can be up to 100000. Set to zero for vanilla experience.

karosieben_modpack.label: Resource Reach Distance Bonus
karosieben_modpack.description: Bonus distance for mining. Can be up to 1000. Set to zero for vanilla experience.

karosieben_modpack.label: Alternative localisation
karosieben_modpack.description: Provides an alternative localisation for names of items. By now only __ITEM__basic-electronic-components__ will be changed to __ITEM__basic-electronic-components2__. More to come.

karosieben_modpack.label: Alternative graphics for __ITEM__angels-ore4__
karosieben_modpack.description: The icon for __ITEM__angels-ore4__ doesn't look different to the icon for __ITEM__quartz__. This setting changes that.

karosieben_modpack.label: Alternative recipe for __ITEM__gun-cotton__
karosieben_modpack.description: The recipe for __ITEM__gun-cotton__ is pretty resource-intense. This setting provides an alternative recipe with __ITEM__cellulose-fiber__, which is more efficient.

karosieben_modpack.label: Centrifuging recipes for ores
karosieben_modpack.description: Adds centrifuging recipes to void every ore you get from refining. This is useful, if you have to much of one ore.

karosieben_modpack.label: Add composting recipes to biological products

gas-boiler.label: Make vanilla fluids burnable
gas-boiler.description: Fuel_value from solid-fuel proportionally applied to vanilla petroleum fluids.

gas-generator.label: Make vanilla fluids burnable
gas-generator.description: Fuel_value from solid-fuel proportionally applied to vanilla petroleum fluids.

upgraded_gas-generator.label: Make vanilla fluids burnable
upgraded_gas-generator.description: Fuel_value from solid-fuel proportionally applied to vanilla petroleum fluids.

upgraded_gas-generatorUpdated.label: Make vanilla fluids burnable
upgraded_gas-generatorUpdated.description: Fuel_value from solid-fuel proportionally applied to vanilla petroleum fluids.

eve-weaponry.label: Enable EVE Ammo for Rampant Rifle Turret
Enable EVE Ammo for Rampant Minigun

companionship.label: Minimum number of desired companions
companionship.description: If below this number, the game will be UPS limited.\ndefault = 2

companionship.label: Game speed when not enough companions
Desired game speed for individual player

Hexy_MadClown_Tweaks.label: Remove particle accelerators
Hexy_MadClown_Tweaks.description: Remove particle accelerators and the free science pack from power recipes. remove-research-facilities=Remove research facilities and the science packs from fluids recipes.

Hexy_MadClown_Tweaks.label: Remove alternate red/yellow ammo recipes
Hexy_MadClown_Tweaks.description: Remove the alternate recipes MadClown's adds for yellow ammo and red ammo.

Hexy_MadClown_Tweaks.label: Tweak nuclear
Hexy_MadClown_Tweaks.description: Disable thorium-plutionium fuel cells, as well as remove the polluiton modifier that Bob's mods add to normal nuclear fuel.

Hexy_MadClown_Tweaks.label: Buff uranium hexafluoride centrifuging
Hexy_MadClown_Tweaks.description: Make it so that hexafluoride centrifuging uses closer to 1/2 the uranium ore used for normal uranium ore centrifuging rather than 2/3 the uranium ore used.

Hexy_MadClown_Tweaks.label: Fix pure sorting recipe crafting times
Hexy_MadClown_Tweaks.description: Make MadClown's pure ore sorting recipes have 1/1.5 second crafting times instead of 0.5 second crafting times.

Hexy_MadClown_Tweaks.label: Buff sand/alluvium sluicing
Hexy_MadClown_Tweaks.description: Make sand sluicing have 2.5x the yield, and alluvium sluicing have 5x the yield these recipes normally do to make them more appealing.

Hexy_MadClown_Tweaks.label: Remove desalination for magnesium recipes
Hexy_MadClown_Tweaks.description: Remove the magnesium from salt water desalination recipes, as they make obtaining magnesium too easy.

Hexy_MadClown_Tweaks.label: Rebalance MadClown's science pack recipes
Hexy_MadClown_Tweaks.description: More expensive science pack recipes have double the yield, and less expensive science pack recipes have less yield. Make the automation science pack II recipe require less materials. Make the logistic science pack II recipe require more chrome to compensate for the decreased alloy requirement of the default recipe. Switch cobalt plate and osmium plate in the production science pack III and high tech science pack III recipes.

SchallVirtualSignal.label: Enable tertiary colour signals
SchallVirtualSignal.description: In addition to primary and secondary colours (3+3) provided in vanilla signals, this option adds the tertiary colours (6) as signals.

SchallVirtualSignal.label: Correct naming of magenta signal
SchallVirtualSignal.description: The magenta signal (#FF00FF) is wrongly named as "pink" signal (#FFC0CB) in English (probably also in other locale).  This option corrects it.

SchallVirtualSignal.label: Background Greek letter signals
SchallVirtualSignal.description: "Blue": Same as vanilla text signals (Latin letter and number signals).\n"Cyan": (Default) Similar but enough contrast from vanilla Latin letter signals.\nNote that the other colours may require enabling of tertiary colour signals.

SchallVirtualSignal.label: Enable XL signals +1
SchallVirtualSignal.description: Signals with 2× linear size (4× area) of standard icons.  Designed to be used as oversized map chart tags.

SchallVirtualSignal.label: Enable XL signals +2
SchallVirtualSignal.description: Signals with 3× linear size (9× area) of standard icons.  Designed to be used as oversized map chart tags.

SchallVirtualSignal.label: Enable XL signals +3
SchallVirtualSignal.description: Signals with 4× linear size (16× area) of standard icons.  Designed to be used as oversized map chart tags.

SchallVirtualSignal.label: Enable XL signals +4
SchallVirtualSignal.description: Signals with 5× linear size (25× area) of standard icons.  Designed to be used as oversized map chart tags.

SchallOilFuel.label: Add burnt fuel inventory to vehicles
SchallOilFuel.description: Entities under category “car” and using chemical fuel, such as __ENTITY__car__ and __ENTITY__tank__.

SchallOilFuel.label: Add burnt fuel inventory to locomotives
SchallOilFuel.description: Entities under category “locomotive” and using chemical fuel, such as __ENTITY__locomotive__.

SchallOilFuel.label: Add burnt fuel inventory to spider vehicles
SchallOilFuel.description: Entities under category “spider-vehicle” and using chemical fuel, such as Light Spidertron in “Schall Arachnid Platoon” mod.

SchallOilFuel.label: Add burnt fuel inventory to inserters
SchallOilFuel.description: Entities under category “inserter” and using chemical fuel, such as __ENTITY__burner-inserter__.

SchallOilFuel.label: Add burnt fuel inventory to mining drills
SchallOilFuel.description: Entities under category “mining-drill” and using chemical fuel, such as __ENTITY__burner-mining-drill__.

SchallOilFuel.label: Add burnt fuel inventory to boilers
SchallOilFuel.description: Entities under category “boiler” and using chemical fuel, such as __ENTITY__boiler__.

SchallOilFuel.label: Add burnt fuel inventory to furnaces
SchallOilFuel.description: Entities under category “furnace” and using chemical fuel, such as __ENTITY__stone-furnace__ and __ENTITY__steel-furnace__.

SchallOilFuel.label: Add burnt fuel inventory to assembling machines
SchallOilFuel.description: Entities under category “assembling-machine” and using chemical fuel.

SchallOilFuel.label: Add burnt fuel inventory to generator equipment
SchallOilFuel.description: Equipment under category “generator-equipment” and using chemical fuel, such as Vehicle fuel cell in “Schall Tank Platoon” mod.

SchallOilFuel.label: Fuel pollution rebalance
SchallOilFuel.description: Off: (Default) Vanilla setting, no differences among fuels.\nOn: Increases pollution from dirty fuels (e.g., __ITEM__coal__, __ENTITY__crude-oil__.)  Decreases pollution from cleaner fuels (e.g., __ITEM__rocket-fuel__, Petroleum gas.)

FactorioTweaks.label: Alt Mode Default
FactorioTweaks.description: Toggle default alt mode state, Default: true

FactorioTweaks.label: Ammo Magazine Size Multiplier
FactorioTweaks.description: Adjust ammo magazine size multiplier, Default: 1

FactorioTweaks.label: Item Stack Size Multiplier
FactorioTweaks.description: Adjust item stack size multiplier, Default: 20

RitnTeleportation.label: The same map for everyone :
RitnTeleportation.description: The map will be the same for all, the one configured at the base.

chujianduidie.description: 可以修改人物初始速度(0为默认15速度，范围0 - 200)

Assembler_Assay.label: Crafting machine MTBF
Assembler_Assay.description: Mean Time Between Failures, in minutes

Assembler_Assay.label: Require foundations
Assembler_Assay.description: Machines need solid foundations.  Without proper support, they take damage and need regular repairs.  Different levels of flooring offer different levels of support, with damage stopping at refined-concrete.

Assembler_Assay.label: Pollution clogging
Assembler_Assay.description: Machines in heavily polluted areas are more likely to break.  Tied to MTBF.

Assembler_Assay.label: normal difficulty
Assembler_Assay.description: Assembler Assay difficulty on normal mode.  Machines simply need to be processed.

Assembler_Assay.label: expensive difficulty
Assembler_Assay.description: Assembler Assay difficulty on expensive mode. Machines will need replacement parts.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Enable new deuterium recipes
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Adds new textures and recipes for deuterium processing in the Angel's style.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Remove Bob's valves
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove Bob's valve, overflow valve, and topup valve.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Remove Bob's water bores
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove Bob's water bores, along with all their recipes.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Remove Bob's electrolyzers
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove Bob's electrolyzers, and move the recipes the machines originally had to other machines.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Remove Bob's small tanks
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove Bob's small tank and small inline tank.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Remove Bob's repair packs
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove Bob's new repair packs.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Remove Bob's beacons
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove Bob's new beacons, as they are overpowered.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Remove Angel's fish recipes
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove Angel's bioprocessing fish recipes, as they currently have no use.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Remove Angel's meat recipes
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove Angel's meat recipes and butchery, as they currently have no use.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Remove Angel's alien bioprocessing recipes
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove Angel's biter bioprocessing recipes, as they currently have no use. If Bob's Enemies is not present, also removes alien bioprocessing entirely. This changes Mushredtato's processing to give crystal dust instead of alien bacteria, as well as change red algae to give sodium perchlorate.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Remove silver metal paste
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove silver metal paste, as it has no use even with Bob's Enemies.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Remove phosgene
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove the phosgene gas recipe, as it currently has no use.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Remove ammonium chloride
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove the ammonium chloride recipe, as it currently has no use.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Remove Angel's calcium chloride recipe
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove the Angel's calcium chloride recipe in favor of keeping Bob's calcium chloride recipe.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Remove coal liquefaction
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove coal liquefaction, as it is superceded by Angel's coal cracking recipes.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Enable new nitroglycerin recipe
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Enable a new nitroglycerin recipe and texture that fits Angel's better. This also modifies Explosives II to use nitroglycerin, as it is the same materials in it.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Liquid fuel and deuterium use normal barrels
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Force liquid fuel and deuterium to use normal barreling recipes. If PetrochemPlus is present and the "Replace Gas Barrels with Gas Cylinders" option is enabled then deuterium will stay in a gas barrel.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Fix productivity inconsistencies
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove productivity on heavy water electrolysis, calcium chloride, explosives I, and lithium cobalt oxide. In addition, move productivity on Angel's rubber from the rubber recipe to the liquid rubber recipe, to make it consistent with plastic and resin.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Remove productivity on Bob's warfare intermediates
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove productivity on all Bob's warfare intermediates, as this is a weird inconsistency between vanilla and Bob's warfare.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Angel's resin and rubber recipe use Bob's icons
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Change Angel's resin and rubber recipe to use Bob's resin and rubber icons, as they are weirdly inconsistent.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Rubber and resin tweaks
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Bob's resin recipe no longer takes productivity, to make Angel's resin more appealing. Bob's rubber recipe is removed, and the yield of Angel's rubber I is doubled to compensate as it is now the only way to make rubber. Red and green wire use tinned copper wire instead of insulated wire. If used with PetrochemPlus, this setting will OVERRIDE PetrochemPlus's changes.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Silicon wafer tweaks
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Silicon wafers can now be crafted in electronics assembling machines, and take 2 seconds to craft instead of 5.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Remove Angel's glass fiber
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove the Angel's glass fiber recipe and fiberglass board from glass fiber recipe.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Bob's assembling machines module slots tweak
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Makes it so Bob's assembling machines have 1-2-3-4-5-6 module slots instead of 0-2-4-5-5-6 module slots.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Chem plant tweaks
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: =Removes Bob's chem plants and the vanilla chem plant, and adjusts Angel's chem plant speeds to be more in line with Bob's chem plants. The Angel's chem plant is used in the production science recipe, and has the same recipe as the old chem plant.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Technology cleanup
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove extraneous prerequisites for Angel's smelting techs that don't need them anymore, make bronze processing its own tech, restructure oil techs, remove dependencies on alloy processing/chemical processing, restructure Bob's warfare/equipment/vehicle equipment techs, add prerequisites to Angel's industries techs, and other miscellaneous changes which are too numerous to list here.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Make technologies require respective science pack techs
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Make it so that each technology requires its respective science pack tech. This excludes series of numbered techs where the tech is not the start of the series to reduce clutter and be consistent with vanilla.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Clean up Angel's casting recipes
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove recipes for Angel's casting intermediates that are never used for anything.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Easier lead III smelting
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove hexafluorosilicic acid from lead III smelting. The recipe that originally produced lead anodes now produces lead ingots, making lead III smelting actually viable.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Cheaper gemstone crystallization
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Crystallizing gems from crystal seedling and crystal catalysts now costs 10 crystal seedling instead of 50 to make it actually viable.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Ceramic filtering tweaks
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Ceramic filtering returns enough sulfuric waste water to be sulfur positive, making it viable for filtering.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Hybrid catalysts crafted in assembling machine
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Hybrid catalysts are crafted in an assembling machine instead of a crystallizer, as this makes more sense.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Move gemstone intermediates to gemstones tab
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Move grinding wheels/polishing compound/polishing wheels to the Bob's Gemstones tab to make them easier to find. Move the "Sort Raw Gems" recipe next to the geode crushing and gemstone ore crystallization recipes, as it makes more sense there.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Remove Bob's fluids and Bob's materials tabs
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove the Bob's fluids and Bob's materials tabs entirely, moving their contents to other tabs.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Add nuclear tab
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Add a nuclear tab containing the nuclear processing recipes as well as the nuclear power structures.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Move offshore pump to water processing
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Move the offshore pump to the Water Treatment tab, as it makes more sense to be there rather than production.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Move rocket silo to production tab
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Move the rocket silo to the production tab, as it is not a military building.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Move ore silos/warehouses/large chests to logistics tab
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Move ore silos/warehouses/large chests to the logistics tab, alongside all the other chests. Also gather the logistic versions of each of the chests in the same place as the normal logistic chests.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Reorganize military tab
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Reorganize all of the military intermediates and military items into 4 different tabs: combat for weapons/ammo, armor for armor and its equipment, vehicles for cars/tanks and vehicle equipment, and foritifications for walls/turrets/radars.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Merge intermediates tabs
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Make it so that there is only one intermediates tab instead of two.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Reorganize logistics tabs
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Reorganize the existing Logistics and Bob's Logistics tabs into a Logistics tab, a Fluid Handling tab, and a Robots tab.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Enable new lithium processing recipes
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Make lithium perchlorate require sodium perchlorate as it does in real life, giving it an extra use. Sodium perchlorate now only requires green catalysts to compensate. Lithium cobalt oxide now requires lithium chloride instead of lithium metal, eliminating the lithium metal recipe entirely. Deuterium fuel reprocessing now returns lithium chloride to compensate.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Stone brick tweaks
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Makes stone brick stack to 1000 to be consistent with clay brick/concrete/reinforced concrete. Also moves the stone brick recipe to Angel's casting.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Remove Angel's industries tabs
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Remove both Angel's industries tabs and merge their contents into other tabs.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Use Angel's fertilizer for Bob's greenhouse recipes
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Use Angel's fertilizer for Bob's greenhouse recipes, eliminating Bob's fertilizer entirely. Also makes cosmetic changes to the Bob's fertilizer tech to make it make more sense after the changes. Does nothing if Bob's greenhouses isn't present.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Fix ferrous/cupric sludge recipes
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: The amount of sludge produced by the ferrous/cupric sludge recipes are multiplied by 10 to fit in line with the other recipes.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Nutrient pulp can be clarified
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Nutrient pulp is clarifiable, since Angel's bioprocessing does not enable this by default and it is useful to be able to clarify it.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Solder tweaks
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Bob's solder recipe now produces 4 solder instead of 8, making it actually worse than Angel's casting solder rather than better.

Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.label: Remove ingredient count limits
Hexy_AngelBob_Tweaks.description: Removes ingredient count limits from all machines. If Bob's Assembling Machines's "Factory ingredient limits" option is enabled, this option does nothing.

No_Power_Icons.label: Transparency of Icons
No_Power_Icons.description: At 100%, icons are completely invisible. Lower values are more opaque. 0% is vanilla behavior, useful if you just want to scale the icons.

No_Power_Icons.label: Change 'No Fuel' Icons
No_Power_Icons.description: If checked, the blinking red fuel icons are included. This should work for any burner entity, including vehicles, boilers, furnaces, etc.

No_Power_Icons.label: Change 'No Ammo' Icons
No_Power_Icons.description: If checked, the blinking red no ammo icons are included. This includes gun turrets, modded gun turrets, and vanilla flamethrower turrets (which use the no fuel icon).

No_Power_Icons.label: Icon Scaling
No_Power_Icons.description: Scales icons the given amount - 0.5 is half, 2.0 is double size. Only affects fuel and ammo if they are enabled.

No_Power_Icons.label: Change 'Out Of Network' Icons
No_Power_Icons.description: If checked, the blinking yellow 'Out of logistic network' icons are included. This includes icons for all types of logistic chest.

EndgameExtension.label: Productivity bonus for Master Productivity Modules
Tick to enable Productivity Beacon activation/deactivation messages.

adamo-nuclear.label: Replace vanilla uranium in recipes.
adamo-nuclear.description: Search all recipes, replacing vanilla uranium ingredients and results with equivalent Adamo Nuclear materials.

adamo-nuclear.label: Override uranium belt recipes.
adamo-nuclear.description: Alter ingredients in uranium belt recipes to be consistent with nuclear materials calculations.

yield-ores.label: Minimum yield
yield-ores.description: Resource yield will not drop below this amount. (1.0 means 100% yield)

yield-ores.label: Maximum yield
yield-ores.description: The highest yield a resource entity can have. (1.0 means 100% yield)

yield-ores.label: Limit yield
yield-ores.description: When enabled, resource yields are limited by the maximum yield.

GCKI.label: Show debug messages in the game
GCKI.description: Should debug messages of this mod be shown in the game?\n(Unless you're debugging this mod, you probably won't need to turn this on.)

GCKI.label: Enable long reach
GCKI.description: Usually, you can only place your vehicle in the vicinity of your character (default game settings: radius of 10 tiles). If you have mods installed that extend your reach, check this option to be able to place your vehicle farther away.\n (WARNING: If you have any mod that extends your reach very far, this will allow you to teleport your character to distant locations if it is inside the vehicle. It is recommended to not activate this option!)

GCKI.label: Show info about destroyed/stolen vehicles on the ground
GCKI.description: If active, a message will be left for you on the spot where your vehicle was just before somebody stole or destroyed it. The message will be visible only to you.

GCKI.label: Duration of these messages (in seconds)
GCKI.description: Set the time (in seconds) after which messages about destroyed/stolen vehicles are removed again.\n(Allowed values: 1-3600; default: 300)

GCKI.label: Write debug messages to log file
GCKI.description: Should debug messages of this mod be written to factorio-current.log?\n(Usually there's no need to clutter up your logfile, but if you run into problems with this mod, please turn this on and include the output in your bug report!)

GCKI.label: Color of these messages
GCKI.description: Set the color of messages about destroyed/stolen vehicles.\n(These messages can only be seen by one player, so messages for other players don't get into the way and you can use the color that suits you best.)

GCKI.label: Teleport to other surfaces
GCKI.description: If you're in a vehicle owned by somebody else, the owner may summon the vehicle and everything inside just about anywhere at any time. Usually you will be summoned along with the vehicle. However, if this option is not active, you will be ejected from the vehicle before it is moved to another surface (e.g. a Factorissimo building).

GCKI.label: Use icons from "Gizmos Car Keys - Zahnfeechen Patch"
GCKI.description: Are you used to the keys from "Gizmos Car Keys - Zahnfeechen Patch"? Then you can replace the default icons here!\n(This option changes just the icons, nothing else!)

No_Bots_Please.label: Hide bot cargo in alt mode
No_Bots_Please.description: When alt mode is enabled, bots carrying cargo will have the icon for the carried item shown, same as vanilla. Enable this to remove them and more completely hide bots.

ltn-cleanup.label: Clean failed deliveries
ltn-cleanup.description: If delivery fails, try to clean the train

LTN_Combinator_Modernized.label: Show all panels
LTN_Combinator_Modernized.description: Always show Requester and Provider setings regardles of detected stop type.  A depot will still hide all settigns.\n\n[color=blue]Default:[/color] [color=green]False[/color]

LTN_Combinator_Modernized.label: Show network panel
LTN_Combinator_Modernized.description: Always show the Network ID configuration panel.\n\n[color=blue]Default:[/color] [color=green]False[/color]

LTN_Combinator_Modernized.label: Request slider maximum stacks (items)
LTN_Combinator_Modernized.description: The maximum number of items (stacks) you can request using the slider.  You may still enter larger values directly.\n\n[color=blue]Default:[/color] [color=green]256[/color]

LTN_Combinator_Modernized.label: Request by stacks
LTN_Combinator_Modernized.description: If checked, requests for items will be entered as stacks instead of individual count.\n\n[color=blue]Default:[/color] [color=green]True[/color]

LTN_Combinator_Modernized.label: Request slider maximum (fluid)
LTN_Combinator_Modernized.description: The maximum units of fluid that can be requested using the slider.  You may still enter larger values directly.\n\n[color=blue]Default:[/color] [color=green]500k[/color]

LTN_Combinator_Modernized.label: Disable newly built LTN combinators
LTN_Combinator_Modernized.description: If enabled, all placed LTN Combinators will be disabled.\n\n[color=blue]Defalut:[/color] [color=green]False[/color]

windturbines.label: Low VRAM mode
windturbines.description: Reduces the amount of rotations by half

windturbines-2.label: Low VRAM mode
windturbines-2.description: Reduces the amount of rotations by half

windturbines.label: Locked power output
windturbines.description: On default (Off), the power production scales with animation- and wind speeds

windturbines-2.label: Locked power output
windturbines-2.description: On default (Off), the power production scales with animation- and wind speeds

biter_extermination.label: Disable game pollution
biter_extermination.description: On launch pollution is disabled and removed from the game to save UPS. This will remove pollution across all surfaces in the game at first use.

biter_extermination.label: Gas capsule recipe cost
biter_extermination.description: How many units the recipe costs. Each unit is: 1 atomic bomb, 25 poison capsules, 10 steel.

biter_extermination.label: Technology cost
biter_extermination.description: How many units the technology costs. Each unit is: 4 military, 2 space and chemical, 1 of each other science pack. Set to 0 to disable the research from appearing.

SchallAutolinkedChest.label: Default inventory limit __ENTITY__Schall-autolinked-chest-1__ (48)
SchallAutolinkedChest.description: Similar to how the user manually set the draggable red bar to limit storage size, however, this is now automatically applied on all inventories with new link ID (i.e., newly built chests).

SchallAutolinkedChest.label: Link chests on built
SchallAutolinkedChest.description: On entity built.\nOnly apply on autolinked chests of this mod.\nWhen built next to each other, they are automatically linked to share the same inventory.

SchallAutolinkedChest.label: Link chests on hotkey & shortcut
SchallAutolinkedChest.description:
On hotkey and shortcut.
Only apply on autolinked chests of this mod.
All selected chests will be linked to share the same inventory.
You may switched this option off, if you consider linking non-neighbouring chests as mild cheating.

SchallAutolinkedChest.label: Link ID display
SchallAutolinkedChest.description: Display as flying text on selection.

ScrappersDelight.label: Disable Leaky Capacitor Drain?
ScrappersDelight.description: By default, the Leaky Capacitor leaks 5kW/sec energy. To make the battery drain power, its equipment type had to be changed to belt-immunity-equipment. Functionally, the battery works identically to any other battery, charging when energy is in excess and charging other equipment when necessary, however, the changed equipment type means that even though the battery still works the same, it doesn't visibly display the exact numbers of its energy storage. It only displays the green bar of its buffer. If this is inconvenient, this option can be checked to disable the energy drain on the Leaky Capacitor and change the capacitor from belt-immunity-equipment back to battery-equipment so it displays its exact energy value.

ScrappersDelight.label: Enable Manual Generator?
ScrappersDelight.description: If checked, enables the Manual Generator, which infinitely produces power like the fusion reactor, but only produces 10kW to keep it from overshadowing other power methods like solar equipment. If you feel it still overlaps too much with solar, it can be disabled with this setting.

ScrappersDelight.label: Patchwork Roboport Robot Count
ScrappersDelight.description: How many robots should the Patchwork Roboport hold? Default: 2

ScrappersDelight.label: Patchwork Roboport Build Range
ScrappersDelight.description: How much build range should the Patchwork Roboport have? Vanilla MK1 Roboport is 30. Default: 25

ScrappersDelight.label: Patchwork Roboport Charge Pads
ScrappersDelight.description: How many robots should the Patchwork Roboport charge at once? Default: 1

ScrappersDelight.label: Patchwork Roboport Bot Charge Rate
ScrappersDelight.description: How fast should the Patchwork Roboport charge robots, in kilowatts? Default: 1000

ScrappersDelight.label: Patchwork Roboport Energy Buffer
ScrappersDelight.description: How much power should the Patchwork Roboport store, in kilojoules? Factorio's Roboport MK1 stores 35MJ, or 35000 kJ Default: 2500

ScrappersDelight.label: Patchwork Roboport Recharge Rate
ScrappersDelight.description: How fast should the Patchwork Roboport itself recharge, in kilowatts? Default: 1000

ScrappersDelight.label: Leaky Capacitor Capacity
ScrappersDelight.description: How much power should the Leaky Capacitor store, in kilowatts? Default: 5000

ScrappersDelight.label: Hodgepodge Manual Generator Power Production
ScrappersDelight.description: How much power should the Hodgepodge Manual Generator produce, in kilowatts? Default: 15

ScrappersDelight.label: Makeshift Generator Fuel Efficiency
ScrappersDelight.description: How efficient should the Makeshift Generator be with its fuel. Default: 25%

ScrappersDelight.label: Makeshift Generator Pollution Per Minute
ScrappersDelight.description: How much pollution per minute should the Makeshift Generator produce? Default: 1

ScrappersDelight.label: Makeshift Generator Power Production
ScrappersDelight.description: How much power should the Makeshift Generator produce, in kilowatts? Default: 50

ScrappersDelight.label: Experimental Shield Energy Buffer
ScrappersDelight.description: How much energy should the Experimental Shield store in reserve, in kilowatts? Default: 120

ScrappersDelight.label: Experimental Shield Energy Per Hitpoint
ScrappersDelight.description: How much energy should the Experimental Shield use per hitpoint, in kilowatts? Default: 20

ScrappersDelight.label: Experimental Shield Max HP
ScrappersDelight.description: How much total hp should the Experimental Shield have? Default: 20

ScrappersDelight.label: Experimental Shield Recharge Rate
ScrappersDelight.description: How much energy should the Experimental Shield recharge per second, in kilowatts? This amount divided by Shield Energy Use Per Hitpoint will give the hp regen per second. Default: 120

SmartPowerSwitcher.label: Default Threshold
SmartPowerSwitcher.description: Missing amount of items/fluids triggering a power on.\nCan be overridden with signal.\ndefault = 5000

GUI_Unifyer.label: Top button style
GUI_Unifyer.description: Defines the color and shape of top-left buttons

GUI_Unifyer.label: Top frame style
GUI_Unifyer.description: Defines the style of the top-left frame containing buttons

vacuum-cleaner.label: Display "enabled toggle" messages
vacuum-cleaner.description: If enabled, the game will display messages when the pickup enabled state is toggled while the GUI is not open

vacuum-cleaner.label: Display "inventory full" messages
vacuum-cleaner.description: If enabled, the game will display messages when attempting to automatically pickup items that can't fit in your inventory

vacuum-cleaner.label: Notification delay time
vacuum-cleaner.description: The minimum number of seconds between identical "inventory full" messages

assemblyanalyst.label: Ignore inserters [img=info]
assemblyanalyst.description: Excludes inserters from your analysis zones to reduce the total amount of entities that are being tracked, improving performance.

assemblyanalyst.label: Magnetic selection [img=info]
assemblyanalyst.description: Magnetic selection snaps the analysis area to the outside borders of the machines in your selection.

assemblyanalyst.label: Reset data on change [img=info]
assemblyanalyst.description: Resets the data collected about a particular zone when a relevant entity is added to or removed from it.

assemblyanalyst.label: Re-snap on change [img=info]
assemblyanalyst.description: Re-applies the magnetic selection algorithm when a relevant entity is added to or removed from a particular zone.

Electric_Transformators.label: Short circuit on electric network id __1__
Electric_Transformators.description: Short circuit on electric network id __1__

Electric_Transformators.label: Efficiency
Electric_Transformators.description: Efficiency of power conversion (as percentage)\nminimum: 1, maximum 100, default: 98

Electric_Transformators.label: Check for electric shorts
Electric_Transformators.description: Interval of the check for electric shorts (as ticks)\ndisable: 0, default: 600

AlertsList2.label: Percentage readout
AlertsList2.description: Disabled: Display value as input signal value. Enabled: display value as percentage of input signal in relation to right hand part of circuit condition.
Shows alert list as either grid of icons, or list of icons and alert messages

improved-spacex-ftl.label: Technology cost
improved-spacex-ftl.description: Changes the amount of science packs required for the two Faster than Light technologies. Note that you need to launch rockets to obtain the science packs.

improved-spacex-ftl.label: FTL propulsion requires space science
improved-spacex-ftl.description: Toggles whether the final research stage requires space science packs *in addition to* the new FTL research packs. Effectively doubles the amount of rockets you will need.

inserter-throughput.label: Rounding precision
inserter-throughput.description: Maximum amount of digits to display after the decimal point. Set to 0 to disable rounding.

inserter-throughput.label: Show the toggle button
inserter-throughput.description: Shows a button in the upper left corner, which indicates the state of the "Enabled" setting and can be used to change this setting without going into mod options.

UltimateBelts_Owoshima_And_Pankeko-Mod.label: Recipes base on Bobs mods
UltimateBelts_Owoshima_And_Pankeko-Mod.description: Changes the recipes of this mods belts to use stuff from Bobs Plates if available. Will balance vanilla requirements if Bobs Plates is unavailable.

UltimateBelts_Owoshima_And_Pankeko-Mod.label: Ultimate belts follow up Bobs belts
UltimateBelts_Owoshima_And_Pankeko-Mod.description: Let the lowest tier of Ultimate Belts follow up the highest tier of Bobs Logistics.

UltimateBelts_Owoshima_And_Pankeko-Mod.label: Organize miniloaders in Bobs Logistics tab
UltimateBelts_Owoshima_And_Pankeko-Mod.description: Miniloaders will show up in Bobs Logistics tab in stead of the base Logistics tab.

WireBox.label: Mode
WireBox.description: Changes which wires will be added by the tool.

landmine-thrower.label: Land mines leave ghosts
landmine-thrower.description: Whether land mines should leave ghosts for construction bots.\n\nNot recommended but left as an option in case disabling ghosts causes problems with other mods.

landmine-thrower.label: Increased land mine resistance
landmine-thrower.description: Gives land mines 99% damage reduction to physical (biter) and acid (spitter/worm) damage.

landmine-thrower.label: Land mine thrower range
landmine-thrower.description:
Base range of the landmine thrower.

super-generous-recipes.description: Does not do anything. Only here to separate each of the categories.

baguette_super_generous.label: --  General Settings  --
baguette_super_generous.description: Does not do anything. Only here to separate each of the categories.

super-generous-recipes.label: Global Recipe Multiplier
super-generous-recipes.description:
Multiplies the below recipe properties by the given value.
-Recipe Requirements (Requires: 'Allow Requirement Amount Editing')
-Recipe Item Output (Requires: 'Allow Recipe Output Editing of Items')
-Recipe Fluid Output (Requires: 'Allow Recipe Output Editing of Fluid')
-Receipt Crafting time (Requires: 'Allow Crafting Time Editing')

baguette_super_generous.label: Global Recipe Multiplier
baguette_super_generous.description:
Multiplies the below recipe properties by the given value.
-Recipe Requirements (Requires: 'Allow Requirement Amount Editing')
-Recipe Item Output (Requires: 'Allow Recipe Output Editing of Items')
-Recipe Fluid Output (Requires: 'Allow Recipe Output Editing of Fluid')
-Receipt Crafting time (Requires: 'Allow Crafting Time Editing')

super-generous-recipes.label: Output Always Give Maximum
super-generous-recipes.description: Always give the maximum amount of output when calculating how much each recipe gives.\nFixes mods that require large amounts of output to work.

baguette_super_generous.label: Output Always Give Maximum
baguette_super_generous.description: Always give the maximum amount of output when calculating how much each recipe gives.\nFixes mods that require large amounts of output to work.

super-generous-recipes.label: Output Always Exceeds Requirements
super-generous-recipes.description: Some recipes require the same item that it outputs. This makes sure the recipe always gives 1 more than is required.\n\nExample: Fixes 'Kovarex enrichment process' giving less Uranium 235 and 238 than it required to be used.

baguette_super_generous.label: Output Always Exceeds Requirements
baguette_super_generous.description: Some recipes require the same item that it outputs. This makes sure the recipe always gives 1 more than is required.\n\nExample: Fixes 'Kovarex enrichment process' giving less Uranium 235 and 238 than it required to be used.

super-generous-recipes.label: --  Allow Item Stack Size Editing  --
super-generous-recipes.description: Allows Super Generous Recipes to edit the Stack Size of items.

baguette_super_generous.label: --  Allow Item Stack Size Editing  --
baguette_super_generous.description: Allows Super Generous Recipes to edit the Stack Size of items.

super-generous-recipes.label: Item Stack Size
super-generous-recipes.description: Maximum Items that will fit in 1 inventory slot.\n\nRequires: 'Allow Item Stack Size Editing'

baguette_super_generous.label: Item Stack Size
baguette_super_generous.description: Maximum Items that will fit in 1 inventory slot.\n\nRequires: 'Allow Item Stack Size Editing'

super-generous-recipes.label: Item Stack Size multiplied by ingredient count
super-generous-recipes.description: Multiply Stack Size by the total amount of ingredients required to make it.\n\nRequires: 'Allow Item Stack Size Editing'

baguette_super_generous.label: Item Stack Size multiplied by ingredient count
baguette_super_generous.description: Multiply Stack Size by the total amount of ingredients required to make it.\n\nRequires: 'Allow Item Stack Size Editing'

super-generous-recipes.label: --  Allow Inserter Stack Size Research Editing  --
super-generous-recipes.description: Allows Super Generous Recipes to modify the amount of stacksize bonus when researching size and capacity bonus for Inserters and stack Inserters.

baguette_super_generous.label: --  Allow Inserter Stack Size Research Editing  --
baguette_super_generous.description: Allows Super Generous Recipes to modify the amount of stacksize bonus when researching size and capacity bonus for Inserters and stack Inserters.

super-generous-recipes.label: Inserter Stack Size Research Bonus
super-generous-recipes.description: Sets the bonus amount Stack Size when researching upgrades that affect increased Stack Size of Inserters.\n\nRequires: 'Allow Inserter Stack Size Research Editing'

baguette_super_generous.label: Inserter Stack Size Research Bonus
baguette_super_generous.description: Sets the bonus amount Stack Size when researching upgrades that affect increased Stack Size of Inserters.\n\nRequires: 'Allow Inserter Stack Size Research Editing'

super-generous-recipes.label: Stack Inserter Stack Size Research Bonus
super-generous-recipes.description: Sets the bonus amount Stack Size when researching upgrades that affect increased Stack Size of Stack Inserters.\n\nRequires: 'Allow Inserter Stack Size Research Editing'

baguette_super_generous.label: Stack Inserter Stack Size Research Bonus
baguette_super_generous.description: Sets the bonus amount Stack Size when researching upgrades that affect increased Stack Size of Stack Inserters.\n\nRequires: 'Allow Inserter Stack Size Research Editing'

super-generous-recipes.label: --  Allow Robot Stack Size Research Editing  --
super-generous-recipes.description: Allows Super Generous Recipes to modify the stacksize bonus research of Robots

baguette_super_generous.label: --  Allow Robot Stack Size Research Editing  --
baguette_super_generous.description: Allows Super Generous Recipes to modify the stacksize bonus research of Robots

super-generous-recipes.label: Robot Stack Size Research Bonus
super-generous-recipes.description: Robot Stack Size increase override for the worker cargo size increase.\n\nRequires: 'Allow robot Stack Size Research Editing'

baguette_super_generous.label: Robot Stack Size Research Bonus
baguette_super_generous.description: Robot Stack Size increase override for the worker cargo size increase.\n\nRequires: 'Allow robot Stack Size Research Editing'

super-generous-recipes.label: --  Allow Recipe Output Editing of Items --
super-generous-recipes.description: Allows Super Generous Recipes to edit the amount of items provided when making a recipe.

baguette_super_generous.label: --  Allow Recipe Output Editing of Items --
baguette_super_generous.description: Allows Super Generous Recipes to edit the amount of items provided when making a recipe.

super-generous-recipes.label: Recipe Output Item Calculation Type
super-generous-recipes.description:
Set the type of calculation done to determine how many items are given from recipes.

--Default--
Uses default values from Vanilla or Mods.

hardened_pipes.label: Maximum distance (hardened pipes-to-ground)
hardened_pipes.description: The value for maximum distance is equal to the number of empty tiles between two hardened underground pipes (default: 9, as for vanilla underground pipes).\nThe amount of ingredients required to make the hardened underground pipes is calculated with the formula "Base value * (maximum distance + 2)".

hardened_pipes.label: Use easy ratios?
hardened_pipes.description: If true, the time needed to produce a pair of hardened underground pipes covering a maximum distance of X is the same needed to produce X hardened pipes. That way, one assembler of hardened pipes will always be sufficient to supply one assembler of hardened pipes-to-ground.\n(Allows for easier setups, but as the time needed to make a pair of hardened underground pipes will be extended, the overall number of assemblers needed to make the same amount will increase!)

RealisticFusionPower.label: Number of pipes processed per tick:
RealisticFusionPower.description: Lower values mean better performance but you may be able to pipe plasma using iron pipes. Set to 0 to disable (only lower if every tenth of an UPS matters or you're too lazy to use magnetic confinement pipes[item=rfp-pipe], and only make it higher if you have a LOT of pipes placed. (16*60 = 960 pipes processed/s default)).\n\n[color=#008cff]DEFAULT = 16[/color]

RealisticFusionPower.label: Science multipler:
RealisticFusionPower.description: Adjust science cost. 0.5 would mean half the science cost, 2 would mean double the science cost, etc. Affects RFW science cost too.\n\n[color=#008cff]DEFAULT = 1[/color]

RealisticFusionPower.label: Enable high capacity versions of the steam turbine[entity=rfp-hc-turbine] and heat exchanger[entity=rfp-hc-exchanger]?
RealisticFusionPower.description:
A single D-T reactor produces 1.4GW to 2GW (depending on efficiency upgrades). Yes, it's possible to use vanilla heat exchangers and turbines, but it's much easier and UPS efficient to use these.

With SE they aren't as useful because SE has their own "high temperature" heat exchanger and turbine, but I still recommend leaving it on because you get RFP D-T fusion much much earlier than you can get SE exchangers and turbines.

[color=#008cff]DEFAULT = ON[/color]

RealisticFusionPower.label: High capacity turbine[entity=rfp-hc-turbine] priority:
RealisticFusionPower.description: Primary means HC turbines[entity=rfp-hc-turbine] will be preffered over normal ones (solar will still be preffered over them), secondary means they will have equal priority.\n\n[color=#008cff]DEFAULT = secondary[/color]

RealisticFusionPower.label: Enable antimatter power? [color=#ff0000][WIP][/color]
RealisticFusionPower.description: Enables power production from matter-antimatter annihilation. You will never have to worry about energy ever again if you build just a single power plant. Needs a LOT of power to kickstart. [color=#ff0000]Currently WIP, there will propably be more researches/complexity in the future.[/color]\n\n[color=#008cff]DEFAULT = ON[/color]

RealisticFusionPower.label: Replace Krastorio 2's fusion/antimatter power(/weaponry if RFW is installed)?
RealisticFusionPower.description: Only visible with Krastorio 2 loaded.\n\n[color=#008cff]DEFAULT = ON[/color]

RealisticFusionPower.label: Replace Space Exploration's antimatter?
RealisticFusionPower.description: If you're going to enable this, I recommend also decreasing the science multiplier. Only visible with SE loaded.\n\n[color=#008cff]DEFAULT = OFF[/color]

RealisticFusionPower.label: Replace Bob's deuterium power(/weaponry if RFW is installed)?
RealisticFusionPower.description: Only visible with Bob's power installed.

RealisticFusionPower.label: Enable deuterium-depleted water to be used in place of normal water?
RealisticFusionPower.description: If enabled, RFP will go through all of the recipes that use water (excluding recipes that output any kind of water) and make a duplicate that uses DDW instead of water. Increases loading time. Does nothing without advanced deuterium extraction.\n\n[color=#008cff]DEFAULT = ON[/color]

RealisticFusionPower.label: Hydrogen sulfide efficiency of the Girdler-Sulfide process (0-1):
RealisticFusionPower.description: Changes the percentage of HS that the GS processes return. 0 = 0%, 1 = 100%.\n\n[color=#008cff]DEFAULT = 1[/color]

RealisticFusionPower.label: Remove K2's tritium if the above option is enabled?
RealisticFusionPower.description: Removes ways to make Krastorio's solid tritium. Turn off only if you use a mod that uses Krastorio's tritium in one of its recipes.\n\n[color=#008cff]DEFAULT = ON[/color]

RealisticFusionPower.label: Replace antihydrogen with SE's antimatter stream?
RealisticFusionPower.description: Turn this off if you want SE's and RFP's antimatter to be separate. Only visible with SE loaded. Does nothing if the "Replace Space Exploration's antimatter" setting is on.\n\n[color=#008cff]DEFAULT = ON[/color]

RealisticFusionPower.label: Make the aneutronic reactor/DEC a composite entity?
RealisticFusionPower.description: Makes the aneutronic reactor + DEC practically a single entity with some scripting magic. Useful for using on Space Exploration's spaceships, because it increases the DEC's area and therefore decreases its energy density.\n\n[color=#008cff]DEFAULT = OFF[/color]

RealisticFusionPower.label: Ratio of RFP to SE antimatter [1:X]:
RealisticFusionPower.description: The number by which antimatter gets multiplied in RFP recipes. Does nothing if both the "Replace Space Exploration's antimatter" and "Replace antihydrogen with SE's antimatter stream" settings are off.\n\n[color=#008cff]DEFAULT = 20[/color]

team_competition.label:
**Deep Rock**
[img=utility/hint_arrow_right]This is your company Space Ship orbiting a mining asteroid. Here is your home and where you build the factory.
[img=utility/hint_arrow_right]The ship has a Rocket on the red area: its a drop pod, where your team is sent to the asteroid to extract que required minerals for profit.
[img=utility/hint_arrow_right]Once on the asteroid, start digging to find the requested resources, mine it and store it on any chest. This is a timed mission, so hurry up.
[img=utility/hint_arrow_right]You are sent with The Mule, a droid that collects nearby resources on chests. Only these collected resources counts toward mission progress.
[img=utility/hint_arrow_right]The Mule is equipped with combat laser to repell nearby enemies, but you should protect it at all costs or fail the mission. There are technologies to upgrade it.
[img=utility/hint_arrow_right]You can call The Mule to your side, pressing [__CONTROL__tc-special-key__].
[img=utility/hint_arrow_right]On the last 5 minutes on the asteroid, the ship will send you a rescue pod. Pack everything and dig you way to it. The mule will try to reach it from now on.
[img=utility/hint_arrow_right]Once the timer reach zero, eveyone near the rescue pod will be rescued back to the ship. Everything left behind is gone for good.
[img=utility/hint_arrow_right]After the extraction, a panel will be shown with mission status, minerals collected, and company profit earned. Check other rival companies performance on the [img=virtual-signal/signal-info]Info panel.
[img=utility/hint_arrow_right]The most profitable Mining Company is the winner!

zero-modules.label: Enable shiny graphics
zero-modules.description: Enable modern-style module graphics from/based on ShinyBob_Icons. Compatible with all color changing options. (Always on when the modules setting of "Artisanal Reskins: Bob's Mods" is enabled.)

zero-modules.label: Vanilla Productivity Colors
zero-modules.description: For some reason Bob's productivity module is pink instead of orange. This setting switches the module colors around so that productivity modules/boards are orange, raw productivity modules are pink, and stank modules are red.

zero-modules.label: Raw Producivity Tech Needs Speed
zero-modules.description: Normally Bob's "speed on Producivity modules" settings adds speed circuits to the recipe of raw productivity modules, but doesn't modify the tech cost to reflect this. This setting adds speed circuit boards to those techs.

zero-modules.label: Green Modules are Green
zero-modules.description: Why are "green" modules yellow? When enabled, this setting switches the colors of the pollution cleaning modules/boards and green modules. (When used with "Artisanal Reskins: Bob's Mods", an additional option is available to defer to that mod's version of this same behavior.)

zero-modules.label: Enable Purple Modules
zero-modules.description: Purple Modules combine speed and productivity in one module with only a slight reduction in energy requirements.

zero-modules.label: Enable Stank Modules
zero-modules.description: Stank modules combine speed and pollution creation in one module without any increased energy requirement. Modules that generate extra pollution can be used beneficially in buildings that generate negative pollution.

zero-modules.label: Enable Extended God Modules
zero-modules.description: Normally god modules only go up to tier 5. This setting extends them to 8 tiers just like the other modules. However, the effect gains per level are decreased so that tier 8 is equivalent to the original tier 5. This makes god modules much more expensive without affecting their strength.

zero-modules.label: More Balanced God Modules
zero-modules.description: Normally god modules can achieve effects stronger than all other regular modules. This setting caps their effects to match those of the other modules.

zero-modules.label: Restrict God Modules to Labs and Miners
Only Show Current Tier of Module Tech
zero-modules.description: Makes the Angel/Bob tech tree less cluttered. Only one tier of module tech will be visible at a time, similar to how upgrade techs work.

Picks-Inserter.label: General: Unblock locked chest slots
Picks-Inserter.description: If a chest does have locked slots, they will be unlocked before putting back items and locked again afterwards. \nIf the chests normally are stuffed with items, that may be helpful to have a save way to always clean the inserters.

Picks-Inserter.label: General: Delete items
Picks-Inserter.description: If the item could not be set back then the inserter will be cleaned up anyway and the items in the hand of the inserter will be destroyed.

Picks-Inserter.label: Selection: Enable inserter cleanup planner
Picks-Inserter.description: Inserters to be cleaned up can be selected.

Picks-Inserter.label: Selection: Clean up permanently
Picks-Inserter.description: Inserters selected will stay selected till they will be deselected and will be cleaned up permanently.

Picks-Inserter.label: Selection:  Maximum number per tick
Picks-Inserter.description: Maximum number of inserters to be cleaned up per tick. \nminimum value: 1 \nmaximum value: 120

Picks-Inserter.label: Train: Clean up inserters at train stops
Picks-Inserter.description: Will do the cleaning up for inserters around cargo wagons when the train leaves a train stop. Therefore, the train has to enter and leave the train stop in "automatic" mode (do not change to "manual" mode in between). \nThe check will be done for the areas on both sides of every cargo wagon connected to the train. Cargo wagons which are not aligned horizontally or vertically will be skipped even if loading / unloading is possible!

Picks-Inserter.label: Train: Area to clean up in width
Picks-Inserter.description: Sets the number of rows in the area of a cargo wagon in which will be searched for inserters to be cleaned up.

Picks-Inserter.label: Train: Extend area to clean up in length
Picks-Inserter.description: Increase the area horizontal in length exceeding the length of the cargo wagon.

IndustrialRevolution.description: Shown when the machine has nothing to do (crafting machines only).

IndustrialRevolution.label: Machine status: Insufficient input [img=info]
IndustrialRevolution.description: Shown when the machine doesn't have enough ingredients to complete its task (crafting machines only).

IndustrialRevolution.label: Machine status: Low power [img=info]
IndustrialRevolution.description: Shown when the available power supply or buffer charge is insufficient.

IndustrialRevolution.label: Machine status: No minable resources [img=info]
IndustrialRevolution.description: Shown when the drill has run out of resources to mine (drills only).

IndustrialRevolution.label: Machine status: Working [img=info]
IndustrialRevolution.description: Shown when the machine is working or ready to activate.

IndustrialRevolution.label: Fuel manager: [img=warning-fuel-red] warn about empty slot [img=info]

IndustrialRevolution.label: Fuel manager: [img=warning-fuel-yellow] warn when no fuel available [img=info]
IndustrialRevolution.description: Alert if any fuel slots are below the threshold but there is no matching fuel in your armour or vehicle inventories. Only shown if the fuel manager is active (quickbar shortcut).

IndustrialRevolution.label: Fuel manager: [img=warning-inventory] warn when inventory full [img=info]
IndustrialRevolution.description: Alert if any spent fuel slots contain items to discard but your armour or vehicle inventories are full. Only shown if the fuel manager is active (quickbar shortcut).

IndustrialRevolution.label: Fuel manager: warning sounds [img=info]

IndustrialRevolution.description: Choose the hue of laser beams (turrets, destroyers, PLD).

IndustrialRevolution.label: Bonus starting items [img=info]
IndustrialRevolution.description: Turning this on gives you a bonus starter kit dependent on your starting tech level. Only affects new game creation.

IndustrialRevolution.label: Rail block colours [img=info]
IndustrialRevolution.description: The colours used for rail block visualisations (e.g. when holding a signal over rails).

IndustrialRevolution.label: Research notifications [img=info]
IndustrialRevolution.description: Shows a notification when you or your team have completed research. Only useful with research queues.

IndustrialRevolution.label: Turret colours [img=info]
IndustrialRevolution.description: By default, turrets in the world are tinted the same colour as the owning player or force. You can choose instead to have each turret use the same fixed tint as its icon.
