RampantFixed.description: Toggles the ai raiding parties distant nests

RampantFixed.label: AI: Enable Siege AI
RampantFixed.description: Toggles the ai siege parties that will settle near the player

RampantFixed.label: World: T1 Acidic Biter Faction
RampantFixed.description: Acid Biter Faction, Major resistance to Acid, Minor resistance to Poison.

RampantFixed.label: World: T2 Laser Biter Faction
RampantFixed.description: Laser Biter Faction, Laser is major resistance, electric is a minor resistance. Has Biters and Spitter unit types. Overdamage protection 1.5 (~80% max hp dmg)

RampantFixed.label: World: T2 Electric Biter Faction
RampantFixed.description: Electric Biter Faction, Only Biters with a short range attack that hits multiple entities in a line. Major resistance to Electric, Minor resistance to Laser.

RampantFixed.label: World: T2 Fast Biter Faction
RampantFixed.description: Fast Biter Faction, High rate of movement, minor resistance to explosive. Overdamage protection 4 (25% max hp dmg), long range immunity(20+)

RampantFixed.label: World: T2 Suicide Biter Faction
RampantFixed.description: Suicide Biter Faction, Only Biters that explode when they attack. Minor resistance to Poison, Fire, Major weakness to explosive. Fast, low HP, overdamage protection 4 (25% max hp dmg), long range immunity(18+)

RampantFixed.label: World: T3 Wasp Biter Faction
RampantFixed.description: Wasp Biter Faction, Spitter only units and each spitter spits small drones.

RampantFixed.label: World: T3 Spawner Biter Faction
RampantFixed.description: Spawner Biter Faction, Only Spitters produced by spawners and spitters make eggs that hatch into biters. Long range immunity(30+)

RampantFixed.label: World: T3 Regenerative Biter Faction
RampantFixed.description: Regenerative Biter Faction, High health regeneration, major weakness to fire, minor resistance to physical, minor resistance to explosive. Overdamage protection 5 (20% max hp dmg)

RampantFixed.label: World: T3 Sapper Biter Faction
RampantFixed.description: Sapper Biter Faction, Major resistance to Electric, Minor resistance to Laser. Destroying powered structures creates draining crystals.

RampantFixed.label: World: T4 Fire Biter Faction
RampantFixed.description: Fire Biter Faction, Major resistance to Acid. Fire immunity. Laser weakness. Fire stream atack.

RampantFixed.label: World: T4 Brutal Biter Faction
RampantFixed.description: Brutal Biter Faction, Only Biters. Major resistance to physical, Major resistance to explosive, Minor resistance to Fire. Minor Weakness to Electric and Laser. Overdamage protection 2 (50% max hp dmg)

RampantFixed.label: World: T6 Inferno Biter Faction
RampantFixed.description: Inferno Biter Faction, Only Spitters that spit flaming acid that burns everything. Extreme resistance to Acid & Fire, Minor weakness to poison. Major weakness to laser

RampantFixed.label: World: T6 Poison Biter Faction
RampantFixed.description: Poison Biter Faction, Only Biters. On death creates a cloud that heals biters and hurts player objects. Major resistance to Poison, Minor resistance to Fire.Minor weakness to Laser, Electric.

RampantFixed.label: World: T7 Nuclear Biter Faction
RampantFixed.description: Nuclear Biter Faction, Only Biters that explode like a atomic bomb. Minor fire resist. Major weakness to explosive. Fast, low HP, overdamage protection 4 (25% max hp dmg), long range immunity(18+)

RampantFixed.label: World: T9 Juggernaut Biter Faction
RampantFixed.description: Slowly, big biters with extreme physical, acid and fire resists. Cloud atack, healing allies and harming enemies. This is a dps-check of your laser defence

RampantFixed.label: Projectiles: Non biter force colliding projectiles
RampantFixed.description: Biter projectiles no longer collide with other biters, worms or nests. Everything else still collides with biter projectiles.

RampantFixed.label: Compatibility: Enable full map scanning
RampantFixed.description: This setting causes the game map to slowly be scanned for entities created or destroyed outside of the factorio event system. (If a mod isnt using script_raised_built or script_raised_destroyed this will cause Rampant to still eventually be consistent with the game map)

RampantFixed.label: Biter, Spitter, Worm, Nest, and Hive Corpse Fade Time
RampantFixed.description: The time in seconds for how long biter corpses stay around

RampantFixed.label: Enable corpse fade time
RampantFixed.description: Enable the fade time to reduce or increase biter, spitter, worm, spawner, and hive. If disabled, no alterations are made to corpse times.

RampantFixed.label: AI: Temperament Rate Modifier
RampantFixed.description: Change how quickly Rampant will hit extremes in the ai temperament stat which control attacking and expanding. This is a percentage increase or decrease with 1 being equal to 100%.

RampantFixed.label: AI: settlements probability in siege/migration mode
RampantFixed.description: Default value = 0.4 (40% settle, 60% atack). Only for migrate/siege mode. Does not affect regular settlements

RampantFixed.label: AI: basic vengence probability per kill
RampantFixed.description: Default value = 0.04. Changes the probability of forming vengence squads after each biter's death.

RampantFixed.label: AI: probability of forming a sequence of vengence squads
RampantFixed.description: Default value = 0.6. The probability of each subsequent vengence squad is multiplied by this coefficient. New aggressive actions of the player instantly increase the probability to the original one. Standard attacks increase the probability gradually. The effect is twice as weak with an excess of AI action points

bztungsten.label: Avoid military science pack
bztungsten.description: If 'yes', rocketry will no longer require military science, allowing research of rocket engine nozzles for saves not using military.

bztungsten.label: Enable the advanced carbon furnace
bztungsten.description: A furnace to smelt tungsten carbide quickly. Meant only for very large factories.

bztungsten.label: Mining fluid amount
bztungsten.description: Amount of fluid (water) needed to mine, default 10. Note, this is displayed as 1/10th the value in some parts of the game.

bztungsten.label: Mining fluid amount for Krastorio2
bztungsten.description: Mining fluid amount for Krastorio2, default 1. Note, this is displayed as 1/10th the value in some parts of the game.

modmashsplinterthem.label: End game modifier
modmashsplinterthem.description: Increase decrease energy required for them to detonate the matter bomb

enemyracemanager.label: Enable Vanilla Bitters [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: Enable vanilla biters. Vanilla bitter will mix with new enemies. Additional corrupted robots join biter as flyer units. \n\nDefault: ON

enemyracemanager.label: Max Enemy Levels [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description:
Enemies will evolve as you advance. 
[font=default-bold]Normal[/font] max at level 10 (enemy damage resist: 70-85%). 
[font=default-bold]Advanced[/font] max at level 15 (enemy damage resist: 85-95%). 
[font=default-bold]Hardcore[/font] max at level 20 (enemy damage resist: 85-95%, higher HP and damage) 

Default: Normal

enemyracemanager.label: Level Requirement Multiplier [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description:
This multiplier increase the evolution points required for enemy to level.  It's useful for expensive recipes or big mods that push the tech level to later stage of the game which take longer to reach.

E.g Space Exploration: Weapon tech 5+ requires space sciences and they take significantly longer to craft. You may want to use 5x in this option. 

Default: 1

enemyracemanager.label: Max Attack Range [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description:
Max Attack Range for extra long range attack units. 
"Advanced - 20" is outside of gun attack range(18). 

Default: Normal

enemyracemanager.label: Enemy Corpse Decompose Time (minute) [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: The time that the enemy's corpses stay. This only affects new races. \n\nDefault: 15

enemyracemanager.label: Enemy Strength Multiplier [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: How strong enemy get for each level. This affects HP, resistance, damage and healing. \n\nRange: 3 - 20, Default: 5

enemyracemanager.label: Unit Max Hit Points Multiplier [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: Enemy hitpoints multiplier. \n\nRange: 5 - 100, Default: 10

enemyracemanager.label: Unit Damage Multiplier [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: Enemy Damage Multiplier. \n\nRange: 1 - 10, Default: 1

enemyracemanager.label: Unit Running/Flying speed multiplier [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: Enemy Running/Flying speed multiplier.  If you are using ultra long range turrets (K2 for example), you should adjust the enemy speed to have a fair fight.  \n\nRange: 1 - 3, Default: 1

enemyracemanager.label: Max Auto Gathering Groups [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: Map setting: Max Gathering Group.  Base game defaults 30. Higher value may have performance implication.  When you increase this number, you should lower max group size number.  \n\nRange: 2 - 50, Default: 15

enemyracemanager.label: Max Group Size [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: Map setting: Max Group Size.  Base game defaults 200. Higher value may have performance implication.  When you increase this number, you should lower max groups number. \n\nRange: 50 - 1000, Default: 100

enemyracemanager.label: Enemy Mapping Method [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description:
This option controls how enemy are spawn when new chunk is mapped. 
[font=default-bold]Default[/font] - All races are mixed together. 
[font=default-bold]2 Races Split[/font] - 2 defined races. Positive axis and Negative axis. 
[font=default-bold]4 Races Split[/font] - 4 defined races at each boundary. Top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right. 
[font=default-bold]1 race / surface[/font] - Each surface has its assigned race. The mod makes sure the spawned unit spawners and worms matches the assigned race.

enemyracemanager.label: [2 races split] Orientation [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: This option controls whether races are divided by (X-axis) East/West or (Y-axis) North/South.

enemyracemanager.label: [2 races split] Race for Positive Axis
[2 races split] Race for Negative Axis
[2 races split] Center point for split [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: This option controls where split starts. e.g -10000 makes split happens at -10000 of the axis you choose above. \n\nRange: -900000 - 900000, Default: 0

enemyracemanager.label: [4 races split] Center point for X Axis [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: This option controls where split starts. e.g -10000 makes split happens at -10000 of X axis.\n\nRange: -900000 - 900000, Default: 0

enemyracemanager.label: [4 races split] Center point for Y Axis [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: This option controls where split starts. e.g -10000 makes split happens at -10000 of Y axis.\n\nRange: -900000 - 900000, Default: 0

enemyracemanager.label: [Defense] Enhanced Base Game Defenses [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: Buff base game's defense items. Armors, vehicles and wall have their damage resistances increase and vehicle's damage output increase. \n\nDefault: ON

enemyracemanager.label: [Attack Meter] Attack group forming interval (min) [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: How often special attack group form with attack meters.  Lower this value if you want more frequent attacks. Pick 1 for death worlds :) \n\nDefault: 3 (up to 20 attacks / hour if you have enough attack points)

enemyracemanager.label: Enable Free For All Mode (BETA)
enemyracemanager.description:
Enable Free For All Mode. Each enemy race will fight each other in this mode. It adds 10x damage to enemies and 12x HP to player entities. It works best with 2 race split or 4 race split
Don't enable/disable this setting on an existing save. The unit may not properly behave.
This mode may have performance implication. 

Default: OFF

enemyracemanager.label: [Enemy Expansion] Building Style [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description:
Define how quickly enemy builds their base. Each build group has an internal timer to decide the time to build. 
[font=default-bold]Default[/font] - 1 unit builds 1 building. 
[font=default-bold]Command Center Expand[/font] - If a unit builds a command center, the group will immediately complete a town using formation setting. 
[font=default-bold]Build a town[/font] - Always builds using formation setting. 
[font=default-bold]Full Expand[/font] - The base fully expands when the first unit of the group builds, using formation setting. 

Default: Build a town

enemyracemanager.label: [Enemy Expansion] Building Formation [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description:
Define the building formation. 1st is number of command centers, 2nd is for support buildings and 3rd is for turrets. 
If the build group doesn't have enough units to build a complete formation, it will build spawners before turrets. 
Random - 3-8 support, 5-12 turrets 

Default: 1-4-5

enemyracemanager.label: [Level Up] Enable Level Acceleration [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description:
Killed Units and turrets are now count toward evolution points calculation.  It's based on spawner destroy factor in map generation. 

1% of spawner destroy factor for each killed units, 10% of spawner destroy factor for each killed turrets 

Default: ON

enemyracemanager.label: [Level Up] Evolution Point Multiplier [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: This multiplier applies to all values which use to calculate evolution points. \n\nRange: 0.1 - 10, Default: 1

enemyracemanager.label: [Attack Points] Enable [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: Enable attack meters.  When attack meter reach its threshold, the race will send out an attack group to attack its enemy's military entities. \n\nDefault: ON

enemyracemanager.label: [Attack Points] Threshold Multiplier [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description:
Threshold multiplier for spawning attack group. 
Formula: MAX_GROUP_SIZE * THRESHOLD_MULTIPLIER * 20. Default setting is 3000 points.
Meter gets 1p/killed unit, 10p/killed turret and 50p/killed spawner. 
Mixed attack group consumes 20p/unit. Flying squad consumes 75p/unit. Dropship squad consumes 150p/unit 

Range: 1 - 50, Default: 1.5

enemyracemanager.label: [Attack Points] Threshold Deviation (%) [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: Threshold deviation percentage. \n\nDefault: 10

enemyracemanager.label: [Attack Points] Point Collector Multiplier (%) [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: Multiplier when collecting attack points for each killed enemies. If you set this to 10, 1 kill will worth 10 points instead of 1 point.\n\nRange: 1-10, Default: 1

enemyracemanager.label: [Flying Squad] Enable [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: Enable flying attack group.  They fly straight to their targeted entity. \n\nDefault: ON

enemyracemanager.label: [Flying Squad] Spawn Chance (%) [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: Flying squad spawn chance. \n\nDefault: 25

enemyracemanager.label: [Dropship Squad] Enable [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description:
Enable Dropship Squad.  They are dedicated groups that fly straight to their target to drop units. They ignore attack distractions. 
This require flying squad to be enable 

Default: ON

enemyracemanager.label: [Dropship Squad] Spawn Chance (%) [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: Dropship spawn chance when flying squad spawns. \n\nDefault: 25

enemyracemanager.label: [Precision Strike] Enable for flying squad [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: Enable flying unit squad to have precision strike feature. They ignore attack distractions. \n\nDefault: ON

enemyracemanager.label: [Precision Strike] Spawn chance for flying squad (%) [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: Chance of flying units squad to spawn with precision strike feature \n\nDefault: 25

enemyracemanager.label: [Precision Strike] Attack Warning [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: Whether you get a notification on mini map when a precision strike group formed. \n\nDefault: ON

enemyracemanager.label: [Time Based Attack] Enable [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description: Enable time based custom attack group. They hate you for being on their world. This starts when enemy is at level 3. \nDefault:ON

enemyracemanager.label: [Time Based Attack] Add points by % [img=info]
enemyracemanager.description:
Percent of the next attack threshold will added to attack meter pool every minute. 
Example: erm_zerg has 3000 points as next attack threshold. 60 points (2%) will be added to attack meter every minute until the next attack threshold reached.  

Default: 2, This takes about 50 mins to fill a custom group attack if you are being passive.

bzfoundry.label: Foundry can smelt
bzfoundry.description: If true, the foundry building can also handle raw ore smelting.

bzfoundry.label: Add refractory recipes (experimental)
bzfoundry.description: [color=orange]EXPERIMENTAL[/color] Ingredients, products, or anything might change.\nUsing one or more refractories, foundries can increase output of plates.\nBe warned, these are complex recipes.

bzfoundry.label: Hydrocarbon for founding
bzfoundry.description:

If [color=cyan]coke[/color], a coke item and recipe is added, if needed.
If [color=cyan]solid fuel[/color], an early but inefficient recipe is added.
If [color=cyan]coal[/color], that is used.
If [color=cyan]none[/color], no hydrocarbon is used in founding (not recommended).

bzfoundry.label: Other machines that can do founding
bzfoundry.description: List of other "assembling-machine" entities that can do "founding" recipes. Eg. Krastorio2's "kr-advanced-furnace", or AAII's "industrial-furnace" (comma-separated list).

modmashsplinterairpurifier.label: Allow Environmental De-evolution

bzlead.label: Lead entities

bzlead.label: More recipes for ammunition.
bzlead.description: Default is lead-only. This adds other options.

modmashsplinterloot.label: Lab loot

modmashsplinterloot.label: Crashed loot allowed
modmashsplinterloot.description: Allows crashed loot on Nauvis or all (requires valid water probability).

bzzirconium.label: Enable cermet
bzzirconium.description: Enable cermet, an advanced intermediate made from ceramics and metals.

bzzirconium.label: Enable stone sorting
bzzirconium.description: Enable "sorting" recipes to convert between zircon and stone. This is no longer as useful for burner phase as it used to be, but left as an option for certain map layouts or existing factories.

modmashsplinterfishing.label: Fishing inserters
modmashsplinterfishing.description: Enables advanced inserter logic, costs UPS

modmashsplinter.label: Titanium ore preference
modmashsplinter.description: Will use the ore name from the selected mod if available, Modmash Spliter will default overides or vanilla items if optional mod missing

modmashsplinterrefinement.label: Ore detection
modmashsplinterrefinement.description: Experimental. Will hunt for any recipe that produces a smeltable item and is in the raw-resource subgroup

LarkenxK2SETweaks.label: Allows Naquium K2 Matter Processing Recipes.
LarkenxK2SETweaks.description: Allows Naquium K2 Matter Processing Recipes.

LarkenxK2SETweaks.label: Allows K2 Steel Pipe, Underground Pipes, and Pumps to be placed on space platforms and spaceships.
LarkenxK2SETweaks.description: Allows K2 Steel Pipe, Underground Pipes, and Pumps to be placed on space platforms and spaceships.

LarkenxK2SETweaks.label: Enable K2 50k and 200k Storage Tanks to be placed on space platforms and spaceships.
LarkenxK2SETweaks.description: Enable K2 50k and 200k Storage Tanks to be placed on space platforms and spaceships.

LarkenxK2SETweaks.label: Make Space Underground Belts have the same max distance as express belts.
LarkenxK2SETweaks.description: Make Space Underground Belts have the same max distance as express belts. Only enabled if long underground belts in K2 settings are also enabled.

LarkenxK2SETweaks.label: Set the max length of underground space pipes. (6-20)
LarkenxK2SETweaks.description: Set the max length of underground space pipes. SE Default is 6, K2 Steel Pipe Undergrounds are 20.

LarkenxK2SETweaks.label: Upgrade the Singularity Lab to have 15 base research speed (1.5x more than space lab).
LarkenxK2SETweaks.description: Upgrade the Singularity Lab to have 15 base research speed (1.5x more than space lab).

LarkenxK2SETweaks.label: Remove the Naquium Tesseract from K2 Stabilizer Recipe.
LarkenxK2SETweaks.description: Remove the Naquium Tesseract from K2 Stabilizer Recipe.

LarkenxK2SETweaks.label: The amount of matter required to create a matter cube.
LarkenxK2SETweaks.description: The amount of matter required to create a matter cube. Space Exploration makes this 2,000 while in K2 it is a lossless conversion ratio for matter cubes (1k -> 1k.)

LarkenxK2SETweaks.label: The amount of matter a matter cube contains and yields when deconverted to back to matter.
LarkenxK2SETweaks.description: The amount of matter a matter cube contains and yields when deconverted to back to matter.

LarkenxK2SETweaks.label: Remove charged stabilizer from vulcanite matter deconversion recipe.
LarkenxK2SETweaks.description: Remove charged stabilizer from vulcanite matter deconversion recipe since core mining enables vulcanite on Nauvis anyway.

LarkenxK2SETweaks.label: Adjust K2 Matter Stabilizers from 99% likely to be returned to 99.5%.
LarkenxK2SETweaks.description: Makes K2 Matter Stabilizers 99.5% likely to be preserved versus 99%.

LarkenxK2SETweaks.label: Change the matter deconversion ratios for K2+Vanilla ores.
LarkenxK2SETweaks.description: Change the matter deconversion ratios for K2+Vanilla ores. In K2, these ratios are lossless (1:1). Space Exploration nerfs this and makes deconversion 50% as effective (2:1). Recommended to make this still balanced for SE by nerfing K2 ratios, but making the ratio 1.25:1.

LarkenxK2SETweaks.label: Enable Space Exploration Matter Processing Matter Value & Ratio Changes.
LarkenxK2SETweaks.description: Enable Space Exploration Matter Processing Matter Value & Ratio Changes. By default, SE ores are quite expensive to deconvert from matter and the ratios for converting from matter are not consistent (exponential in some cases). This change enables you to override the ratio to a constant value below so that the matter value is always fixed to the deconversion value.

LarkenxK2SETweaks.label: Change the matter deconversion ratios for Space Exploration ores.
LarkenxK2SETweaks.description: Change the matter deconversion ratios for Space Exploration ores. By default, these ratios range from a ~16:1 deconversion ratio to some as steep as 100:1 while also requiring charged stabilizers to produce.

LarkenxK2SETweaks.label: Allow a hypercooler to be placed on spaceships. Also enables some thermofluids production on grounded radiators and particle accelerators.
LarkenxK2SETweaks.description: Allow a hypercooler to be placed on spaceships. Also enables some thermofluids production on grounded radiators and particle accelerators.

LarkenxK2SETweaks.label: Allow K2 Matter Processing buildings in space (not recommended, unbalanced).
LarkenxK2SETweaks.description: Allow K2 Matter Processing buildings in space (not recommended, unbalanced).

SpidertronPatrols.label: Maximum window height scale [img=info]
SpidertronPatrols.description: Decrease this if the bottom of the schedule interface becomes cut off because of your screen resolution or UI scale.

bzcarbon.label: Make a list of modified recipes
bzcarbon.description: If enabled, the text command [color=orange]BZList[/color] will dump a file to the script-output directory with a full list of recipes modified.\nRecommended to turn this off after you are done configuring your other settings.

bzcarbon.label: Enable fullerenes & nanotubes
bzcarbon.description: Enable the fullerenes & nanotubes intermediate products.\nFullerenes are used primarily in bio-related things. Nanotubes for structures.

bzcarbon.label: Enable carbon black
bzcarbon.description: Enable carbon black byproduct. Primarily used to make plastics.

bzcarbon.label: Enable diamond mining
bzcarbon.description: Enables very rare diamond ore patches for new games.

bzcarbon.label: Enable flake graphite
bzcarbon.description: Enables graphite ore patches. Recommended to leave this on. Turning off will remove existing ore patches.

bzcarbon.label: Reuse grinding grit
bzcarbon.description: A chance to reuse diamond grinding grit in recipes like LDS. More complex, but saves resources.

bery0zas-pure-it.label: Pollute from fluid containers
bery0zas-pure-it.description: If enabled your tanks will pollute collected dirty air back to the map

bery0zas-pure-it.label: Max amount of stored pollution
bery0zas-pure-it.description: Sets the maximum amount of pollution which can be stored in fluid containers

modmashsplinterresources.description: Biters drop alien ore probability modifier

Base battery capacity of turret sheilds (in hitpoints)

Milestones.label: Ticks between each check [img=info]
Milestones.description: The mod will wait this many ticks between each completion check. Lower this if you care about time precision, raise if you want less performance impact. If you set this to less than 60, the GUI will also show milliseconds.

modmashsplinterlogistics.label: Loader Snapping
modmashsplinterlogistics.description: Automatically adjust loader in and out

modmashsplinterlogistics.label: Wagon Loader

modmashsplinterlogistics.label: Allow Inserter Adjustments
modmashsplinterlogistics.description: Enables or disable inserter pickup location adjustments

Kux-OrbitalIonCannon.label: Early recipe
Kux-OrbitalIonCannon.description: The research is possible earlier

modmashsplintersubspacelogistics.label: Subspace tech
modmashsplintersubspacelogistics.description: Alters the subspace and containment tech tree

modmashsplintersubspacelogistics.label: Max recipe stack
modmashsplintersubspacelogistics.description: Allows stack generated recipes to not exceed x items. Containment and super material

modmashsplintervalkyries.label: Player deploy modifier
modmashsplintervalkyries.description: reduces distance valkyries will deploy from player ports includes Spidertrons

bzsilicon.label: When using Bio Industries, use crushed stone to make silica.
bzsilicon.description: This setting is experimental, and may be removed in a future update. It's strongly recommended to keep it enabled. Only disable if your UPS is dropping due to inserter count. Added per user request.

modmashsplinterunderground.description: Original will add vanilla and requested, Experimental will try detect all possible

reskins-angels.description: Reskins the intermediates, recipes, and technologies as well as the algae farm, arboretum, bioprocessor, butchery, composter, farms, hatchery, nutrient extractor, press, refugiums, tree seed generators and seed extractors added by Angel's Bioprocessing.

reskins-angels.label: Angel's Industries

reskins-angels.label: Angel's Refining

reskins-angels.label: Angel's Smelting

CapsuleAmmo.label: Max number of capsules per ammo item
CapsuleAmmo.description: If you have mods that add more capsules then a high setting (3 or more) can grow the number of recipes, ammo items and researches created to insanly high numbers. But with just vanilla capsules there's only a few thousand possible combinations so go nuts if you want to.

CapsuleAmmo.label: Research required
CapsuleAmmo.description: 'No' means all recipes are enabled by default. 'Levels only' means research for each amount of capsules is needed. 'Individual recipes' means one research to unlock each recipe, but no research for the levels and no prerequisites on the ingredients used (ammo and capsules). 'Complete' is everything combined with the addition of prerequisites for the ingredients (so you can't unlock recipes which require ingredients you haven't unlocked yet). The research graph for 'Complete' looks a bit messy in the research viewer because of the way Factorio orders things so at least in the alpha version the other options are provided for testing purposes.

CapsuleAmmo.label: Fraction in magazine with capsule
CapsuleAmmo.description: For each individual bullet shot this will be used as a probability of triggering each capsule effect individually. The recipe cost will be scaled accordingly, rounded up to the nearest whole capsule, so multiples of 0.1 are preferred to not have to pay more than necessary. This value exists because a value of 1.00 (100%) means that you launch capsules at an insanely high rate. Simple grenade magazines or almost any other capsule becomes many times stronger than uranium rounds instead of being a utilty round.

CapsuleAmmo.label: Recipe type for multi-capsule ammo
CapsuleAmmo.description: Simple means 1 of each thing on the icon. Complex means you need the subset ammo types as ingredients instead of capsules. Poison + Slowdown capsules in a explosive rocket then requires poison capsule explosive rocket and slowdown capsule explosive rocket. "Complex, cheap" (cheaper than "Simple") means you get the as many output ammo items as inputs used, which effectivly means you pay 1 capsule per ammo regardless of level. Or 2 explosive rockets + 1 poison capsule + 1 slowdown capsule finally ends up as 2 explosive rockets with poison + slowdown. "Complex, expensive" (more expensive than "Simple") always gives 1 ammo output, which effectivly means you pay more ammo items but the same number of capsules as the simple recipe. Cost in ammo items (not counting the capsules) is then n_capsules factorial, or for 1 capsule ammo with 1 to 4 capsules it costs 1, 2, 6, 24 ammo items in total.

TerrainEvolution.label: Dynamic daily cycle

Adds an annual cycle to the game. The duration of the day, night, twilight is calculated separately for each day. To simplify calculations, a year lasts 360 days, 30 days in a month. The crash occurred on the 1st of the 1st year. 90th, 270th day - equinox, 180 - summer solstice, 360 - winter solstice. 
 Presets: 
 Winter is coming - half a year is a very short day, half a year is a very short night 
 Middle-earth - daily cycles like in middle latitudes 
 Equator - the default factorio world with short nights and twilight without a dynamic change in duration

Kux-BlueprintExtensions.label: Snap to edge centers blueprint first
Kux-BlueprintExtensions.description:
ON: Snapping to an edge centers the blueprint on the opposite axis.
OFF: Snapping to an edge does not move the blueprint on the opposite axis.

Setting this to OFF means that snapping to North + snapping to East is the same effect as snapping to Northeast, useful if you have limited keybind space (e.g. no numpad).

Kux-BlueprintExtensions.label: Invert horizontal axis when snapping
Kux-BlueprintExtensions.description: Snap to East/West moves that edge of the blueprint to under the cursor rather than aligning the blueprint to that edge.

Kux-BlueprintExtensions.label: Invert vertical axis when snapping
Kux-BlueprintExtensions.description: Snap to North/South moves that edge of the blueprint to under the cursor rather than aligning the blueprint to that edge.

Kux-BlueprintExtensions.label: Increment version when updating blueprints (normal)
Kux-BlueprintExtensions.description:
Blueprint Extensions can add a version number to blueprints it updates.

OFF: Blueprint labels are always copied as-is.

IF PRESENT: A blueprint label ending in "v.###" or "v###" will have the version number incremented.

ALWAYS: Like IF PRESENT, but "v.2" will be added to blueprint labels if no version number is present.

This setting only applies when using regular mouse drag to select the new blueprint area.

Kux-BlueprintExtensions.label: Increment version when updating blueprints (alternate)
Kux-BlueprintExtensions.description:
Blueprint Extensions can add a version number to blueprints it updates.

OFF: Blueprint labels are always copied as-is.

IF PRESENT: A blueprint label ending in "v.###" or "v###" will have the version number incremented.

ALWAYS: Like IF PRESENT, but "v.2" will be added to blueprint labels if no version number is present.

This setting applies when using SHIFT + drag to select the new blueprint area.

Kux-BlueprintExtensions.label: Show buttons for blueprint flipping
Kux-BlueprintExtensions.description: Show GUI buttons for flipping blueprints.  If disabled, blueprints can only be flipped by using the hotkey.\n\nThis setting is ignored if Blueprint Flipper and Turner is installed.

Kux-BlueprintExtensions.label: Mirror GDIW recipes
Kux-BlueprintExtensions.description: 'Gah! DarnItWater!' is a mod that adds mirrored versions of recipes with fluid inputs/outputs.  If this is enabled and GDIW is present, recipes in blueprints will be mirrored when the blueprint itself is mirrored.

Kux-BlueprintExtensions.label: Mirror Fluid Permutation recipes
Kux-BlueprintExtensions.description: 'Fluid Permutations' is a mod that adds mirrored versions (and more) of recipes with fluid inputs/outputs.  If this is enabled and Fluid Permutation is present, recipes in blueprints will be mirrored when the blueprint itself is mirrored.

Kux-BlueprintExtensions.label: Show buttons for in-place blueprint rotation
Action upon landfilling a blueprint
Kux-BlueprintExtensions.description:
UPDATE IN-PLACE: Adds landfill to the current blueprint.  The resulting changes cannot be undone.

MAKE A COPY: Creates an identical copy of the current blueprint with landfill added.  Changes can be undone by switching to the original blueprint.

MAKE A TEMPORARY COPY: The copy is deleted when cleared from the cursor.  Temporary copies can be made permanent by manually dropping them in an inventory or the blueprint library.

planetImagingSatellite.label: The "virtual" width of the world.
planetImagingSatellite.description: The width of the map that will be exposed as the virtual planet.  This value is in tiles to the right of the rockets launch site.  So the "virtual" planet is twice this value.  For example, a value of 10,000 will result in a "virtual" planet 20,000 tiles across, 10,000 to the left of the rocket silo and 10,000 to the right.

planetImagingSatellite.label: Number of ticks between each tile is revealed
planetImagingSatellite.description: The amount of time it takes for the next tile to be revealed.  This number is in ticks, the larger the number the longer the wait till the next tile is shown and the slower the map is revealed.

planetImagingSatellite.label: Increase or decrease the height of the waveform that determines what part of the map is revealed.
planetImagingSatellite.description: The map is revealed in a wave form much like a satellites actual track on a map of the world.  This multiplier affects the height of that wave.  A larger value will increase the region above and below the rocket launch site that will be revealed.  A large value will also result in slower mapping as there is more territory to reveal.

planetImagingSatellite.label: Increase or decrease the width (or frequency) of the wave form in which the map is revealed.
planetImagingSatellite.description: Similar to the amplitude multiplier, a larger value here will cause the wave form to be spread out (left-to-right) and will complete a full mapping of the "virtual" planet in less time than a smaller number.

factorio_world_multiplayer.label: Exponent for apparent evolution.
factorio_world_multiplayer.description:
apparent evolution is (game evolution) ^ (evolution factor exponent). 
You can experiment with values other than 1... for example at value 2 game evolution 50% will translate to 25% apparent evolution. (0.5^2=0.25). 

After some experimenting, I decided I don't know how to use it, to make game more balanced, but I left it implemented in code, so you can change it. 

When it is at 1, resource count of newly discovered spawn location grow linearly from "Early ore multiplier" to "Late ore multiplier" as evolution grows.. If you set it to 2, or (let's say) 5, resources will grow very, very slowly at early stages of evolution, so you can set late_ore_exponent to pretty high value, so players joining at high evolution level might get more starting resources (if they spawn has not been discovered yet)... Yeah, it's a bit overcomplicated.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Lithium will spawn directly if 248k is present.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.resource_editor_icon]Add Ores: Angel's refined ores
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Chrome, Manganese, and Platinum, will spawn directly if Angel's mods are present.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.resource_editor_icon]Add Ores: Angel's misc.resources
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Clay, Fluorite, Limestone, Salt, Sand, and Soil will spawn directly if Angel's mods are present.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.resource_editor_icon]Add Ores: MadClown01's refined ores
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Osmium, Magnesium, and Phosphorus will spawn directly if MadClown01's mods are present.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: The richness of deep sea oil patches (in % of normal).\n[img=info]Needs Cargo Ships and "Add Ores: Deep sea oil and natural gas" to have an effect.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.resource_editor_icon][img=utility.hint_arrow_right]Deep sea gas frequency
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: The frequency of deep sea natural gas patches (in % of water-only chunks).\n[img=info]Needs Cargo Ships, Angel's Petrochem, and "Add Ores: Deep sea oil and natural gas" to have an effect.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.resource_editor_icon][img=utility.hint_arrow_right]Deep sea gas richness
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: The richness of deep sea natural gas patches (in % of normal).\n[img=info]Needs Cargo Ships, Angel's Petrochem, and "Add Ores: Deep sea oil and natural gas" to have an effect.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.resource_editor_icon][img=utility.hint_arrow_right]Deep sea fissure frequency
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: The frequency of deep sea fissures (in % of water-only chunks).\n[img=info]Needs Cargo Ships, Angel's Petrochem, and "Add Ores: Deep sea oil and natural gas" to have an effect.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.resource_editor_icon][img=utility.hint_arrow_right]Deep sea fissure richness
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: The richness of deep sea fissures (in % of normal).\n[img=info]Needs Cargo Ships, Angel's Petrochem, and "Add Ores: Deep sea oil and natural gas" to have an effect.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.scripting_editor_icon]Feature: Belt speed overhaul
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Adjusts the speed of belts to try to provide a consistent but non-linear progression. Will override the equivalent settings in Bob's Logistics, but will make use of the "basic"/"white" belts that mod provides if they are present. The intent is to make later tier belt upgrades as impressive as early upgrades, rather than going from say 60 to 75 which is not a significant increase.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.scripting_editor_icon]Feature: Biological process speed buffs
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Greatly increases speed of most biological processes to reduce the number of facilities needed (and improve UPS).

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.scripting_editor_icon]Feature: Equipment and grid overhaul
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Will update known armors, vehicles, and equipment to unify their functions and grid sizes.\n[img=utility.warning_icon]Note that this may result in equipment unknown to GUFT not being usable, as well as potentially resizing existing grids.\n[img=utility.warning_icon]It is recommended you remove any equipment from any armor you are using before enabling this.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.scripting_editor_icon][img=utility.hint_arrow_right]Angel's vehicle equipment handling
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: If both Angel's and Bob's equipment are enabled, Angel's is more powerful to the point of rendering some of Bob's obsolete. This allows you to decide if the equipment should be included unchanged ("As-Is"), rebalanced to be more in line with Bob's ("Rebalanced"), or not at all ("Not Included").

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.scripting_editor_icon][img=utility.hint_arrow_right]Enable player equipment in vehicles
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Allow player equipment to be used in vehicles. Recommended on if not playing with a mod that adds vehicle equipment (such as Bob's Vehicle Equipment) to enable vehicle shields etc. Requires equipment and grid overhaul above to function.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.scripting_editor_icon]Feature: Hide recipes from hand crafting that cannot be hand-crafted
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Recipes that cannot be crafted by hand (by category or by involving a fluid) will not be visible in the hand crafting menu. They can still be selected in machines. This can make it easier to find recipes when you know what you're looking for, but may make discovery of new recipes more difficult.\n[img=info]A recipe book mod like FNEI is recommended if you enable this.\n[img=utility.warning_icon]Not all recipes seem to respect being hidden from the hand craft menu. I have yet to figure out why.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.scripting_editor_icon]Feature: Magic barrels
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Barrel and barrel-like items (like Bob's gas cylinders and canisters) no longer consume empty containers when producing filled containers, nor does emptying produce empty containers. This can make certain logistical aspects much easier if you don't enjoy that part of the game.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.scripting_editor_icon]Feature: Minining drill area reduction
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Reduce miner area from 5x5 to 3x3, which can make designs more compact when ores overlap but will reduce how many mines can be placed on the edge of a patch.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.scripting_editor_icon]Feature: Ore spawn logic replacement
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Override all supported ore spawn with custom rates etc. This will attempt to create a more useful rate of ore spawns, with ores that are needed in smaller quantities being rarer and harder to find.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.scripting_editor_icon][img=utility.hint_arrow_right]Ore spawn rate multiplier
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Typical ore spawn rate will be multiplied by this value. Set lower for less frequent ores. Requires Ore spawn logic replacement above to be enabled. Very small values may lead to ores being difficult to impossible to find (beware enemy base density!). Very large values may impact worldgen performance.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.scripting_editor_icon]Feature: Productivity updates
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Enable productivity for recipes that should have had it, as well as make Angel's agricultural modules work in appropriate Bio Industries and Yuoki Industries buildings.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.scripting_editor_icon]Feature: Increase radar ranges
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Increases radar max scan range significantly and slightly increases max vision range. May be especially beneficial if playing with rare resource deposits.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.scripting_editor_icon]Feature: Unicomp overhaul
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Will replace existing Yuoki unicomp conversions with lossy ones that consume refined resources to produce raws. Adds support for conversions to other mods' resources where appropriate.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.enemy_force_icon]Balance: Swap crystals for gems in module recipes
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Makes modules cost gems instead of crystals. Beacons still require crystals.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.enemy_force_icon]Balance: AAI vehicle cost changes
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Increases the raw cost of AAI vehicles and their technologies.\n[img=info]Overall this makes all vehicles after the Chaingunner more expensive. Requires Bob's mods.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.enemy_force_icon]Balance: Remove artifacts from Bob's equipment recipes
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Removes artifacts from personal/vehicle equipment that normally requires them.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.enemy_force_icon]Balance: Angel's ore sorting results multiplier
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Changes the amount of ore received per operation at each structure that turns Angel/Clown ores (or their processed stages) into sorted ores. Will also increase yield of waste such as slag or acids.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.decorative_editor_icon]Misc: Earlier Logistics Requester chests
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Changes Logistics Requester Chests to unlock with Logisitcs Robotics instead of Logistics System. This allows them to be unlocked without Utility science packs, allowing the use of logistics robots earlier in the game. Has no effect if Angel's Industries is installed, which does something similar.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.decorative_editor_icon]Misc: Fragile burners
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Burner mining drills and burner inserters return their components when mined instead of the entity itself. This allows you to reclaim the resources as normally these are not used in any other recipes.\n[img=utility.warning_icon]Due to technical limitations this will always use the "normal" cost for the refund, not the "expensive" recipe, even if your save is set to expensive mode.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.decorative_editor_icon]Misc: Offshore/ground pumps produce water if Omnimatter is installed
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: By default, Omnimatter changes offshore and ground water pumps to produce Omnic Water instead of regular water. This undoes that.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.decorative_editor_icon]Misc: Enable standard (chemical) fuel in Yuoki locomotives
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Allow Yuoki locomotives to run on chemical fuel (coal, wood, etc.) regardless of tier.\n[img=info]Yuoki Diesel/Future trains will still accept their normal fuel types as well.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: [img=utility.surface_editor_icon]Infinite Ores: Enable
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Traditionally-finite ores will be set to a very large richness (technically finite, but not in any typical playthrough). Traditionally-infinite ores will be set to not deplete over time.

grand-unified-factorio-theory.label: Debug: Log verbosity
grand-unified-factorio-theory.description: Affects the detail guft will log. 0 (Off) by default.\n[img=utility.warning_icon]This setting is typically hidden.

space-trains.description: Minimum battery state for charging, can be drained under that level only if fuel is under its minimum too. Good for defense.

space-trains.label: Min train state [%]
space-trains.description: Battery minimum state is ignored, if train fuel state is under this level. It is better to keep moving, if train is under attack.

space-trains.label: Max train state [%]
space-trains.description: Will not charge train fuel from batteries above this level. Usefull with solar panels/charging stations and using grid for defense/constructions.

rz-IR2CompatibilityFixes.label: Re-add Industrial Revolution's Transmat
rz-IR2CompatibilityFixes.description: Keep this on if you want to use Industrial Revolution 2's Transmat (normally disabled if K2 is installed).

rz-IR2CompatibilityFixes.label: Keep Planetary Teleporter
rz-IR2CompatibilityFixes.description: Keep this on if you want to use Krastorio 2's Planetary Teleporter.

rz-IR2CompatibilityFixes.label: Tech Recipe Tweaks
rz-IR2CompatibilityFixes.description: Changes Tech Card recipes to have crafting time of 20 seconds, but produce 5 times the results, like in K2. Also adds 5 Blank Tech Cards as ingredients for them.

rz-IR2CompatibilityFixes.label: Adjust K2 Lab Speeds
rz-IR2CompatibilityFixes.description: Sets Advanced Lab speed to 4 and Singularity Lab speed to 10 so that the speed for the labs are Singularity > Quantum > Advanced > Electric > Copper, which matches tech progression.

rz-IR2CompatibilityFixes.label: Quantum Lab recipe ingredient tweak
rz-IR2CompatibilityFixes.description: Adds Advanced Lab as an ingredient to the Quantum Lab recipe.

rz-IR2CompatibilityFixes.label: Remove wood from Electronic Circuit recipe
rz-IR2CompatibilityFixes.description: Normally, wood is part of the ingredient if K2 is also installed. Can remove it if preferred, since Glass is already used as an insulator, so removing wood make it more "realistic."

rz-IR2CompatibilityFixes.label: Enable Atomic Artillery Shell
rz-IR2CompatibilityFixes.description: Keep the regular atomic artillery shell from IR2 or the K2 one or both.

rz-IR2CompatibilityFixes.label: Crusher Settings
rz-IR2CompatibilityFixes.description: Regular is default.\nAssembling Machine turns Crushers into Assembling Machines so you have to select the ingredients.\nThis setting is useful because you can place Productivity Modules into Crushers, but you can insert an ingredient for a recipe that can't use Productivity Modules, so it just becomes a wasted module slot.

rz-IR2CompatibilityFixes.label: Arc Furnace Affected by Speed Modules
rz-IR2CompatibilityFixes.description: Allows Arc Furnace to be affected with Speed Modules (default: false).

puzzlebots.description: Increases the recharge speed of roboports but reduces battery size of logistic bots. Makes bots less suited for long range operation while increasing the number of bots supportable by a single roboport. Increases bot speed slightly to compensate for more frequent recharge trips.

puzzlebots.label: 6x6 logistic range
puzzlebots.description: Increases the logistic area of roboports to 6x6. Makes the restrictions on bots slightly more flexible, notably by allowing logistic networks to bridge a railroad.

DedLib.description: Logger level for in game console prints

Ingredient_Scrap.label: Calculate scrap amount by ingredient amount
Ingredient_Scrap.description: Calculate the scrap amount by adding ingredient amounts (on) or the number of ingredients (off).\n\nBe aware that by disabling both ([img=sigma-symbol] and [img=gears-symbol]) options you technically reducing ALL costs by your set probability.

Ingredient_Scrap.label: Scrap amount limitation
Ingredient_Scrap.description: "clamps" the range of scrap amount, removes insane amounts of scrap\n\nBe aware that by disenabling both ([img=sigma-symbol] and [img=gears-symbol]) options you technically reducing ALL costs by your set probability.

Ingredient_Scrap.label: Recycle recipes which must be available at start
Ingredient_Scrap.description: Comma separated list of scrap names whose recycling recipes should be available at the beginning.\nExample:\ntitanium-scrap, chromium-scrap, tungsten-scrap
There should be no problems by leaving this enabled but under certain circumstances it can prevent issues with mod compatibility.

BatteryElectricTrain.description: Top speed of wagons and battery-electric locomotives (if enabled). [10 – 7386.3 km/h]

BatteryElectricTrain.description: Increase the top speed of all cargo, fluid and artillery wagons to match the locomotive.

BatteryElectricTrain.label: Equipment grid for locomotives
BatteryElectricTrain.description: Choose which type of equipment grid from other mods to use for battery-electric locomotives.

BatteryElectricTrain.label: Battery pack recycling
BatteryElectricTrain.description: About 90 % of real battery packs can be recycled, so add some researchable battery pack recycling recipes. May cause compatibility issues with other recycling mods.

BatteryElectricTrain.label: Return partially discharged battery packs
BatteryElectricTrain.description: Return a discharged battery pack when mining or deconstructing a battery-electric locomotive with a partially discharged battery pack inside, instead of losing it. Can be disabled to save some precious UPS.

hl-Rocket-turret.label: Shooting cooldown
hl-Rocket-turret.description: The cooling time of rocket launcher, 60 = 1 second.

SimpleQualityOfLifeResearchWLK.description: Enables research to increase player reach distance.

BetterBotsWLK.label: Wired Roboports & Roboports Power Fields
BetterBotsWLK.description: Enable Wired Roboports & Roboports Power Fields technologies & functionality

map-tag-generator.description: How the generator should arrange the map tags when multiple will be created at one time. Does not apply to tags for train stops.

Always show dialog window when selecting an area [img=info]
map-tag-generator.description: If enabled, the dialog window will always appear, even when no tags would otherwise be created. Has no effect if the dialog window is disabled.

map-tag-generator.label: Restrict tag deletion tool [img=info]
map-tag-generator.description: If enabled, the map tag eraser tool will only be able to delete tags that you created with the map tag generator tool. Will be overridden if the per-map version of this setting is enabled.

map-tag-generator.label: Show dialog window when deleting tags
Restrict tag deletion tool for all players [img=info]
map-tag-generator.description: If enabled, then for each player, the map tag eraser tool will only be able to delete tags that they created with the map tag generator tool. Recommended for public servers if you don't want people to be able to erase your tags quickly.

train-throughput-estimator.description: Whether a selection counts all rolling stock entities as part of a single train, or counts each separate train in its entirety

CarEngineer.description: Referring to the buttons top left.\nTo my knowledge these are deprecated but supposedly people still want them so here it is

CarEngineer.description: Does this car have a dead man's switch?\n(does it kill you when exiting the car?)

factorio-nether.description: Determines the scale of the Nether relative to Nauvis. Default is 4 tiles in Nether to 1 tile on Nauvis.

electric-shuttle-train.label: Magnetic Shuttles
electric-shuttle-train.description: If enabled, shuttles will automatically pick up players that they encounter on the rails if they have space, rather than nearly killing them. They may still feel a slight pinch.

electric-shuttle-train.label: Electric Shuttle Excluded Station Name
electric-shuttle-train.description: Enter the name of a station that electric shuttles will be prevented from traveling to.

skip-hours.label: Skip N hours
skip-hours.description: Adds more start items into scenarios/players\n(doesn't affect technologies)

K1_Advanced_fluid.label: Small tank capacity
K1_Advanced_fluid.description: The amount of fluid the small tank can hold. Actual value is multipled by 100. Default is 500.

K1_Advanced_fluid.label: Large tank capacity
K1_Advanced_fluid.description: The amount of fluid the large tank can hold. Actual value is multipled by 100. Default is 2000.

options-early-construction.label: Robots per craft
options-early-construction.description: Sets how many robots are crafted per recipe. Original setting is 6.

options-early-construction.label: Stack size
options-early-construction.description: Sets the stack size of the early construction robots. Original setting is 200.

options-early-construction.label: Free bots
options-early-construction.description: If set crafting the bots does not require ingredients.

options-early-construction.label: Crafting time
options-early-construction.description: Sets how long it takes to craft early construction robots. Original setting is 3.

options-early-construction.label: Robot travel speed
options-early-construction.description: Sets the travel speed of early construction robots. Original setting is 0.06.

spice-rack-lazy-assemblers.label: Classic Lazy bastard
spice-rack-lazy-assemblers.description:
Lazy Bastard gets more challenging. First assembler 2 and oil refineries have to be crafted by hand. Oil refineries can only be crafted in assembler 3.
Factorio 0.16 behaved that way and it challenges to not waste the free handcrafts

(Does nothing if "Crafting Limitation" is disabled)

spice-rack-lazy-assemblers.label: Lazy bastard marathon
spice-rack-lazy-assemblers.description: The first player receives some intermediate products (gears, copper wires) on map start to have a chance to achieve lazy bastard with marathon settings.

spice-rack-oil-change.label: Steam cracking
spice-rack-oil-change.description: Heavy and light oil cracking uses steam instead of water

spice-rack-pollution.label: Effectivity modules
spice-rack-pollution.description:
Change impact of efficiency modules:
Effectivity module 1 has only 20% reduction.

Effectivity module 2 has 60% reduction.

Effectivity module 3 has 200% reduction

spice-rack-pollution.label: Mining drill module slots
spice-rack-pollution.description: The electric mining drill has only 2 module slots instead of 3

spice-rack-pollution.label: Furnace power & pollution
spice-rack-pollution.description:
All furnaces consume more fuel/energy:

The stone furnace consumes more fuel and produces more pollution.
The steel furnace consumes even more fuel, but pollution is like vanilla.
The electric furnace is 1.5 times faster and produces more pollution accordingly. Power requirement is a lot higher, but it has 3 module slots.

The burner mining drill is worse and produces more pollution and consumes more fuel

spice-rack-science.label: Lab
spice-rack-science.description: The lab needs 3 times more power and a lamp to construct (20 lamps are added at the beginning, also for dark moments)

spice-rack-science.label: Production Science & Furnace progression
spice-rack-science.description:
Furnaces depend on lower tiers, so it affects production science pack

The stone furnace is built from stone bricks, which affects early game
The steel furnace just needs additional steel.
The electric furnace needs addtional concrete instead of bricks (less steel compared to vanilla)

spice-rack-science.label: Rocket silo
spice-rack-science.description: The rocket silo research needs additional military science.\nThe rocket silo needs refined concrete instead of concrete and a programmable speaker

spice-rack-tweak-military.label: Long range gun turret
spice-rack-tweak-military.description: New long range gun turret (similar to the range of laser turret) with slower shooting speed.\nIt has lower DPS than a normal gun turret, but benefits more from damage upgrades

spice-rack-tweak-military.label: Flamethrower
spice-rack-tweak-military.description:
The flamethrower turret consumes 3 times more oil and has lot less base damage. The refined flammable research adds more % damage as compensation to let it get stronger in end game.
Crude oil has only 50% damage, heavy oil 70% and light oil 100%.
The flamethrower research is more expensive.
The flamethrower ammo also has less base damage and needs light oil instead of crude oil.

spice-rack-tweak-military.label: Laser turrets
spice-rack-tweak-military.description: Laser turrets have more drain (60kW instead of 24kW)

spice-rack-tweak-military.label: Gun turret damage research
spice-rack-tweak-military.description: Gun turrets (and the new long range turret) profit less from physical damage research to reduce their insane DPS in late game

spice-rack-tweak-military.label: Landmines
spice-rack-tweak-military.description:
Landmines have reduced base damage from 250 to 75 and smaller aoe damage radius (5 instead of 6).
The stronger explosives research add more % damange as compensation to let it get stronger in end game
Arming timeout has increased from 2 to 5 sec. to reduce offensive effectiveness.
The stun time is reduced from 3 to 1.5 sec. but after that, the affected enemy is a lot slower for additional 2.5 sec.
The trigger area is reduced and the hitboxes are a bit smaller to allow placing them denser.

train_realism.label: Air resistance multiplier
train_realism.description: (default 18) area * coeficient. (coef of train is 1.8, sports car 0.3, old car 0.8, cube 2.1) 1.8 * ~10m^2 area = 18

train_realism.label: Friction multiplier
train_realism.description: (default 0.001) steel wheel on steel rail has 0.001-0.002 , car on asphalt can have 0.01, car on sand can even reach 0.3 . This value is actually modified in code, because friction force should be just weight*velocity*this, but then more weight you apply, than smaller it gets, so it gets hairy...

train_realism.label: Traction multiplier
train_realism.description: (default 0.3) for reference tyre on asphalt have 1.0, sports car tyre on asphalt have 1.5, steel wheel on rail has 0.3, on wet day asphalt-tyre can go to 0.3 and rail lubricated with leaves might have 0.05 or worse. This is actually equal to number of G's breaking or accelerating can add at most.

train_realism.label: Wheel-slip tarnsfer percentage
train_realism.description:
If your locomotive acceleration force is greater, then it's traction, then if this is set to: 
0.0 - it will only apply "max traction force". Rest will be lost to slipping wheels.
1.0 - all force will be transfered to train and you will practically ignore traction (beware, trains at low speeds have HUUUUUGE torque, so if you set it to 1.0, don't be surprised to see train with 40 wagons reaching 30kmph within 1 second...).
 You can also set it to anywhere between, for example 0.2 will cause slipping train to use 20% of excessive force + 80% of max traction force.

train_realism.label: Particle effects
train_realism.description: If force applied on wheels is greater than force with which train is normally breaking, there are particles showing that wheels are slipping. It can be disabled, because all trains create a lot of particles, because of their huge torque when they just start and particles cost quite some computation time (in my testing world drifting with train doubled script time usage).

train_realism.label: Debug train state
train_realism.description: if train has player it prints all information about current state of train, all forces applied to it.

train_realism.label: Debug message frequency
train_realism.description: each [debug frequency]'th game-tick debug message (described 1 line above) will be printed.

qatmore.label: Alien tech price reduction
qatmore.description: Set to match technology price multiplier. Or whatever integer you like. You may see rounding errors in prices if you set a number whose inverse has infinite digits, i.e. 3, 6, 7, 9, 14, etc.

qatmore.label: More complex alien research
qatmore.description: Alien research packs will have a more complex recipe involving a couple chemical ingredients. Infinite alien research will now require a new platinum research pack.

qatmore.label: Amethyst modules
qatmore.description: Bob's modules use amethysts instead of emeralds to better balance gem usage.

qatmore.label: Cheaper alien artifacts
qatmore.description: Price of converting small alien artifacts to large is decreased from 25 to 10. This is meant to help with alternative enemy mods like Rampant where artifacts are much more scarce.

qatmore.label: Enhanced early ammo recipes
qatmore.description: Early ammo recipes will have increased complexity. Bob's Greenhouse recommended.

qatmore.label: Faster pipes
qatmore.description: More advanced pipes should now be able to transport more fluid. This has not been exhaustively tested yet.

qatmore.label: Fix infinite energy exploits
qatmore.description: Adjusts recipes so that water electrolysis will not give more energy in the form of hydrogen fuel than was needed to produce the hydrogen (unless using modules). This setting can be used with or without Bob's Expensive Electrolysis enabled (both is recommended), with recipes re-adjusted to account for the differences between the two. This setting on its own does not change the energy demand of electrolysers, which will make aluminium and titanium cheaper to produce. Also increases rocket fuel cost for the same reason.

qatmore.label: Less difficult new gold
qatmore.description: Gold will use sodium cyanide for processing instead of mining. This is not the intended production chain and is significantly more expensive.

qatmore.label: Gold revision
qatmore.description: Gold mining/processing will now use sodium cyanide as a solvent.

qatmore.label: Impure ground water
qatmore.description: Ground water will be regular water instead of pure water. Try disabling bodies of water and using landfill on the single lake in your starting area as a challenge run.

qatmore.label: No basic underground belt/spliiter prereq.
qatmore.description: Switches yellow-tier underground belts and splitters to require yellow belts instead of their gray downgrades, thus avoiding the need for wood and copper wire in these production chains.

qatmore.label: Lithium lubricant
qatmore.description: Adds a small amount of lithium to lubricant, in order to expand the number of things lithium is used for.

qatmore.label: Recipe: nickel from iron
qatmore.description: Adds a new method to extract nickel from iron ore, similar to the process for getting cobalt from copper, eliminating the need to mine nickel. Nickel ore patches will remain on the map, but they can be disabled without issue on the Resources tab when starting a new game. NOTE: This setting blocks meteoric iron from spawning from "Special rare ores".

qatmore.label: Nuclear power enhancement
qatmore.description: Increases complexity of nuclear recipes, including new uses for the centrifuge. NOTE: All nuclear changes from this mod will be disabled if the Nuclear fuel update in Bob's Metals, Chemicals and Intermediates mod is not active.

qatmore.label: Nuclear enhancement 2
qatmore.description: Makes adjustments to nuclear power, and adds americium, curium, and californium synthesis to the centrifuge. These are used in personal power equipment and other nuclear things. NOTE: All nuclear changes from this mod will be disabled if the Nuclear fuel update in Bob's Metals, Chemicals and Intermediates mod is not active.

qatmore.label: Ore stack size
qatmore.description: Sets stack size of raw ores. Default for Bob's is 200, base game is 50.

qatmore.label: Oxygen from quartz
qatmore.description: Adds oxygen gas as a byproduct of silicon electrolysis to help balance increased demand for sulfuric acid.

qatmore.label: Pierce enhancement
qatmore.description: Changes non-explosive tank shells to do piercing damage and lowers high-level enemies' resistance to pierce.

qatmore.label: Plasma/laser damage reduction
qatmore.description: Make plasma cannons and personal lasers a little less insanely overpowered so that attackers can pose at least some challenge.

qatmore.label: Special rare ores
qatmore.description: Resource spawner overhaul mod is strongly recommended due to the vanilla game having a lower limit for resource rarity. Adds: Meteoric iron-nickel (NOTE: blocked by the "Recipe: nickel from iron" setting, set that to false); cryolite, low in quantity but cheaper than bauxite, also gives sodium and fluorine; okloite, gives uranium and heavier elements (only with "Nuclear enhancement 2" setting on); and chalcopyrite, gives iron, copper, zinc, and sulfur.

qatmore.label: Silver advanced circuits
qatmore.description: For Bob's Electronics: Blue circuit boards will use silver instead of gold. Note: With this option disabled, it is possible to run a base without any need to mine silver at all.

qatmore.label: Small assembler color shift
qatmore.description: Machine shops and Electronics assembly machines will have slightly different colors to distinguish them from each other and from basic Assembly machines.

Expensive technology modifier. This number multiplies the normal usage of science packs
Numbers with decimals are allowed for fine tuning 
(minimum = 0 (free, basically just 1 item), maximum = 100.000)
Script will default everything to its maximum integer value if it hits the ceiling

DyCore.label: [color=blue]Realistic Recipes[/color]
DyCore.description:
A newly added feature that makes recipes more realistic.
This means every part in a machine has to be crafted and added.
So a stone furnace will require around 200 stone bricks, as it is build brick by brick.

[color=red]This only works on certain recipes, and REQUIRES expensive recipes to be enabled when generating a map.[/color]

Recipes that have no realistic recipe set, will follow the [color=blue]Expensive Recipe Modifier[/color] setting

DyCore.label: [color=blue]Tech Upgrades[/color]
DyCore.description: This will enable the upgrade tech for all DyWorld technologies, which makes the technology screen less cluttered. This will however make it harder to check the next technology in the same line without searching the actual technology tree (right side of the screen)

DyCore.label: [color=blue]Custom Difficulty (scripted attacks)[/color]
DyCore.description:
Custom Difficulty multiplier for scripted attacks.
[color=blue]Peaceful[/color]: No attacks
[color=blue]Easy[/color]: Standard attacks
[color=blue]Medium[/color]: 3x more powerful then Easy
[color=blue]Hard[/color]: 3x more powerful then Medium
[color=blue]Death[/color]: 3x more powerful then Hard

DyCore.label: [color=blue]DyWorld-Dynamics Difficulty[/color]
DyCore.description:
This defines the difficulty of the DyWorld-Dynamics mod. Content will change depending on setting:

[color=blue]Easy:[/color]
Story will have easier objectives
Ammo does more damage
Pollution is normal
Enemies spawn normally

[color=blue]Normal:[/color]
Story has standard objectives
Ammo does less damage
Pollution per machine is increased
Enemies spawn more and stronger

[color=blue]Hard:[/color]
Story objectives are harder
Ammo does even less damage
Pollution per machine is increased even more
Enemies spawn even more and even more stronger

DyCore.label: [color=blue]Survival Difficulty[/color]
DyCore.description:
This governs everything coupled with survival (Food / Water / Temperature (WIP) / Radiation (WIP) / Oxygen (WIP) / Pollution (WIP))

[color=blue]Off:[/color]
Will disable everything. Food and water is no longer needed and wont kill you

[color=blue]Easy:[/color]
Has 2x storages for food and water, and uses it 2 times slower

[color=blue]Normal:[/color]
The default

[color=blue]Hard:[/color]
Will drop your storages for food and water by 2 times (50%), and use it 50% quicker

[color=blue]Insane:[/color]
Will drop you storages to about 30%, and use it 125% quicker then Normal

InfiniteResourcesNormalYieldDepletion.label: Minimum yield in percent
InfiniteResourcesNormalYieldDepletion.description: The minimum % the infinite resource will deplete to.

InfiniteResourcesNormalYieldDepletion.label: Depletion rate (100/value)
InfiniteResourcesNormalYieldDepletion.description:
The "normal" value for infinite resources.  For the purposes of this mod, this is used to determine how quickly the infinite resource will deplete from 100% to the set minimum value at a rate of 100/value in percentage points.
A value of 100 will cause it to deplete at a rate of 1% per mining cycle.
Values under 100 will cause it to deplete faster.  25 means 4% per mining cycle, 50 is 2% per cycle, etc.
Valuse over 100 will cause it to deplete slower.  200 means 1% per 2 mining cycles, while 400 is 1% per 4 cycle, etc.

InfiniteResourcesNormalYieldDepletion.label: Exclusion list
InfiniteResourcesNormalYieldDepletion.description:
Resources to exclude from the affects of this mod.  Names must be entered using their internal game names and separated by commas, with no spaces.

Examples:
To exclude only iron ore, type: iron-ore
To exclude iron and stone ores, type: iron-ore,stone

InfiniteResourcesNormalYieldDepletion.label: Start area only
InfiniteResourcesNormalYieldDepletion.description: Enable if you want this to affect starting resources only.\n\nNote, changing this to true in a running game will delete all resource tiles this mod converted to infinite outside of the starting area and cannot be undone without loading a prior save.
